fdroid:com.burnpony.android.name: BurnPony: Self-Destruct Notes
fdroid:com.burnpony.android.summary: Encrypted notes that burn after reading. Share one link, nothing to install.
fdroid:com.burnpony.android.description:
Send a secret without making the other person install anything.
Write a note, set the self-destruct rules, share one link. The note is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM before anything is uploaded, and it decrypts only in the recipient's browser. The decryption key travels in the part of the link after the #, which browsers never send to any server, so the server stores ciphertext it cannot read, plus a note ID, a view count, and an expiry. No accounts, no names, no analytics.
THREE KINDS OF NOTE
• Simple: one note, one link, optional passphrase
• Double bottom: one link with separate compartments, each opened by its own passphrase. Hand over one passphrase and only that compartment shows; nobody can prove the others exist
• Split key: the note opens only when enough key links are combined, for example any 2 of 3
WHAT YOU CONTROL
• Views: burn after 1 reading, or allow up to 100
• Expiry: 5 minutes to 30 days, changeable later, counted from now
• Scheduled opening: the note stays hidden, looking like it does not exist, until the time you pick
• Optional passphrase, stretched with PBKDF2 and mixed into the key. Send it through a different channel than the link
• Open immediately: skip the confirmation screen when a note should open on the first visit
• Auto-hide: the revealed note re-hides after a timer
• Read receipts, disclosed to the recipient before they reveal the note. BurnPony does not do silent read tracking
• Defaults for new notes, set once in Settings
• A private label for your own list; it never leaves your device
• QR code for in-person handoff: the whole link, key included, transfers with no network at all
SAVED COPIES (OPTIONAL, OFF BY DEFAULT)
Keep a copy of a note you send so you can reread it after it burns. You choose per note. Each copy is encrypted to a key held in your phone's secure hardware, which only releases it after your fingerprint, face or screen lock. Double bottom notes are never saved.
TOR AND PROXIES
Route BurnPony through Tor with Orbot, or through any SOCKS5 proxy, with stream isolation. If the proxy is unreachable, requests fail instead of falling back to a direct connection.
HONEST LIMITS
Whoever has the full link (and passphrase, if set) can read the note. A recipient can always copy or photograph a note while it is visible. Self-destruction limits future access; it does not control the moment of reading.
OPEN
The app, the server, the viewer, and the wire-format specification are open source (Apache-2.0), with cross-implementation test vectors shared with the iOS app and the web viewer. Self-hosters can point the app at their own server from Settings. Protocol: https://burnpony.app/protocol
BurnPony is part of the pony family of privacy tools: encryption you can inspect instead of taking a developer's word for it.

fdroid:com.databag.name: Databag

fdroid:com.databag.description:

- Decentralized (direct communication between app and selfhosted server)
- Federated (accounts on different nodes can communicate)
- Public-Private key based identity (not bound to any blockchain or hosting domain)
- End-to-End encryption (the hosting admin cannot view sealed topics, default unsealed)

fdroid:com.procrastilearn.app.name: ProcrastiLearn
fdroid:com.procrastilearn.app.summary: Block distracting apps until you review a spaced-repetition flashcard
fdroid:com.procrastilearn.app.description:
There's Anki on your phone, there's Duolingo, and you do mean to get around to them. Then you pick the phone up, and twenty minutes later you're somewhere in TikTok, not really sure how you got there.
ProcrastiLearn steps in right at that moment. It catches you just as you're about to disappear into another time sink, and asks you for one word first.
That's how mindless app-opening turns into vocabulary practice. Choose which apps you tend to open out of habit — social media, browsers, games — and whenever you launch one, a full-screen flashcard overlay appears. Reveal the translation, rate how well you remembered it, and the app you wanted opens immediately. No subscription, no ads, no accounts.
HOW IT WORKS
Pick the apps you want to gate in the Apps tab. From that point on, opening any of those apps shows a flashcard first. You rate your answer (Again / Hard / Good / Easy) and the FSRS spaced-repetition algorithm schedules the next review automatically. Daily caps prevent you from being overwhelmed.
If you tend to lose track of time once you're inside a gated app, the optional recurring reminder has you covered: set an interval (e.g. every 3 minutes) and the overlay reappears as long as you stay in that app, turning each lingering session into extra review reps.
VOCABULARY
Add words manually or use the optional AI translation feature: paste a word, tap Generate, and the app drafts a translation using OpenAI. The AI prompt is fully editable so you can control tone, context, or target language.
You can also import existing Anki decks (.apkg files) to get started immediately with a vocabulary set you already trust. After that you can be sure that you'll learn it eventually, while watching tiktok or your favourite YouTuber.
Come across a word somewhere else — an article, a chat, another app? Select it and tap "ProcrastiLearn this" from the menu to add it right away, no need to switch apps first.
LANGUAGE SUPPORT
The AI prompt automatically adapts to whatever native and target languages you choose in Settings: explanations appear in your native language, and examples in the language you're learning. Any language pair works out of the box — no manual prompt editing needed. Further language-related improvements will keep arriving, especially based on user requests in GitHub issues or via email.
PRIVACY
All data — vocabulary, blocked apps list, review history, and settings — is stored entirely on your device. There are no analytics, no crash reporters, and no advertising SDKs. The only outbound network traffic is the optional OpenAI API call you initiate by tapping Generate, using your own API key entered in Settings.
PERMISSIONS
Accessibility Service: used solely to detect which app is currently in the foreground so ProcrastiLearn knows when to show the overlay. The service does not read screen content, keystrokes, or any other input.
Display Over Other Apps: required to draw the flashcard overlay on top of the gated app.
OPEN SOURCE
ProcrastiLearn is free and open-source software (Apache 2.0 license). Source code and issue tracker are on GitHub.

fdroid:de.rainerhock.eightbitwonders.name: 8-Bit Wonders
fdroid:de.rainerhock.eightbitwonders.summary: Flexible and easy to use Commodore 8-bit emulation with builtin games
fdroid:de.rainerhock.eightbitwonders.description:
8‑Bit Wonders – Retro Commodore Emulator & Game Center
Step back into the golden age of computing with 8‑Bit Wonders, the all‑in‑one emulator that brings classic Commodore systems to your modern Android device. Play old‑school pixel games, explore vintage software, or enjoy new creations built in the iconic 80s style — all with the convenience and power of today’s hardware. Whether you're reliving childhood favorites or discovering retro computing for the first time, 8‑Bit Wonders delivers an authentic yet modernized experience.
The app supports a wide range of classic Commodore 8‑bit computers: C64, VIC‑20, PET, C128, Plus/4, and C16. It runs smoothly on phones, tablets, and Android TVs, offering broad compatibility across modern devices.
You can use hardware joysticks, gamepads, mice, a virtual touch joystick, and both hardware and virtual keyboards with customizable layouts. Save states and a built‑in time‑machine feature let you rewind gameplay and undo mistakes at any moment. For an authentic retro look, CRT emulation recreates the feel of classic displays.
All disk and tape formats supported by VICE are fully compatible. The app includes an initial library of systems and preinstalled games, and you can expand it by adding your own save states, downloading content directly from archive.org, or importing additional games and applications as 8bw or rp9 files, including those created with tools like C64 Forever.
You can customize your controls by mapping buttons to keystrokes or enabling auto‑fire. A dedicated demo mode lets you play audio in the background or run visual demos in a clean movie‑screen view without Android UI elements.
8‑Bit Wonders is still in development, and your feedback helps shape its future. Share what you enjoy, what needs improvement, and what you would change at: https://eightbitwonders.gitlab.io/app/feedback/
The app retrieves content from archive.org, github.com, gitlab.com, and zimmers.net. . It does not collect personal data; only your public IP address is shared with those services when downloading content.

fdroid:dev.lucanlm.antimine.name: Minesweeper - Antimine
fdroid:dev.lucanlm.antimine.summary: A puzzle game where you search for all hidden mines.
fdroid:dev.lucanlm.antimine.description:
Test your reasoning power on a challenging puzzle game where you have to solve a minefield without exploding any mine.
This is a minimalist and modern version of the classic Minesweeper.
Are you able to clear a minefield? Let’s go!
OBJECTIVE
It's like Minesweeper. You win the game when you've flagged every mine in the minefield. Be careful not to trigger one!
NO GUESSING
This game has an algorithm that always creates solvable minefields. You won't have to guess where the last mine is!
GAME LEVELS
Just like Minesweeper, this game has different levels: Beginner, Intermediate, and Expert. But it also has a unique progressive mode that gets harder when you win.
CUSTOM LEVEL
If the standard modes aren't enough, you can create your level difficulty!
THEMES
Antimine has more than 15 themes (including light, dark, and AMOLED). And soon more will be added!
MINIMALIST
Clean look and feel: a minimalist visual and also lightweight app size (less than 9MB).
TUTORIAL
Don't you know how to play Minesweeper? No problem, you can play our tutorial level and enable Tips on settings.
STATISTICS
Check your results and development.
GAME ASSISTANT
The game will automatically flag the squares you isolated. 
CUSTOMIZATION
You can change the game to make it like you want to. 
Example: Help, animations, haptic feedback, question mark.
CONTROLS
It supports four different control schemes. Example: flag using tap or long press.
ACHIEVEMENTS AND LEADERBOARDS 
You have eight achievements to unlock and different leaderboards to share with your friends.
ONLINE OR OFFLINE
You don't need to be online to play the game!
AUTO-SAVE
You can start a game and continue it later! It will auto-save your game.
Enjoy.

fdroid:github.daneren2005.dsub.name: DSub
fdroid:github.daneren2005.dsub.description:
Connect to your Subsonic server and listen to your music wherever you go. Songs
are cached for playback to save on your mobile bandwidth and to make them
available when you have no connection at all.
* Lockscreen controls (ICS+)
* Gapless Playback (JB+)
* Notification prev/pause/next buttons
* Quick add/remove songs to playlist
* Pause playback when other apps request audio focus (navigation, etc)
* Option to gather logs and send them via email for newer versions of Android
* Drag and drop songs to rearrange your playlist on the Now Playing tab
* User defined Cache Size, Network Timeout, and Buffer Length
Subsonic is a cross-platform FOSS media server that's capable of indexing very
large media collections. The server can transcode if necessary so that the app
can play files that your device may not normally support.
The app is set up to access a demo server on the internet for trying it out. In
order to use this app with your own Subsonic server beyond a trial period, a key
must be obtained by making a donation. (A key isn't required to use the
 Supersonic variant.)

fdroid:me.haroldmartin.golwallpaper.name: GoL Screensaver
fdroid:me.haroldmartin.golwallpaper.summary: Conway's Game of Life screensaver for Onyx Boox devices
fdroid:me.haroldmartin.golwallpaper.description:
GoL Screensaver generates and updates screensavers for Onyx Boox devices using Conway's Game of Life algorithm.
Features:
- Auto-updating screensaver based on Conway's Game of Life
- Customizable foreground and background colors (chosen specifically for color e-ink)

Usage:
- Install the app on using F-Droid or building from source.
- Disable freezing in order to for the game to self-update

 - Note: Updates happen at most every 15 minutes and **only** with sufficient battery
- Launch the app!
 - (Optional) Choose foreground and background colors in the app
 - (Optional) Pick a starting pattern
 - (Optional) Enable the calendar overlay and choose which synced calendars may appear on the screensaver
Calendar privacy and refresh:
- Calendar permission is optional and read-only
- Event titles may be visible on the lock screen; private events are displayed as “Busy”
- Event details are not cached, and calendar settings do not transfer to another device
- Calendar content refreshes with the regular wallpaper job or while the app is open

fdroid:org.cimbar.camerafilecopy.name: CameraFileCopy
fdroid:org.cimbar.camerafilecopy.summary: use your camera to transfer data – even in airplane mode
fdroid:org.cimbar.camerafilecopy.description:
Using animated bar codes, it's possible to send data over the air using only the camera. This app is the barcode decoder (receiver). An encoder (sender) can be seen at cimbar.org .
With CameraFileCopy it is possible to receive data over the camera as a one-way data channel. It does not use any antennas (wifi, bluetooth, nfc, ...) or other tricks. Notably, this means it works just as well in airplane mode.
The app reads animated cimbar codes . Nearly all the interesting logic is from libcimbar – included via a git subtree. The sender component of cfc is a cimbar encoder -- such as cimbar.org . Navigate to that website (or use libcimbar's cimbar_send to generate barcodes natively), open a file to initialize the cimbar stream, and point the app+camera at the animated barcode.

Crouton is simple feature packed recipe organizer & meal planner. The best place to store your favorite recipes from where ever you find them, websites, cookbooks or a handwritten note from your Grandma. 
IMPORT ANYWHERE
Crouton supports importing recipes from almost everywhere! Pull recipes automatically out of websites and just save the bits you need. You can also scan recipes straight out of your recipe book using AI and OCR 
PLAN YOUR WEEK
With your favourite recipes on hand, Crouton makes it very easy to plan your meals for the week (or even long into the future). If you’re stuck for recipe ideas let Crouton automatically generate the meal plan from your organized dinner recipes.
STEP BY STEP MODE
Crouton offers a unique step by step mode. Focus on one recipe step at time as you cook, you can tap on ingredients within a step to get the quantity (saves you jumping back and forth between the steps and ingredients). With hands free mode you can move between steps without touching your device! Perfect for when you have messy hands.
TIMERS
Start timers with a tap. Crouton detects times within recipes and lets you start timers straight from the steps. A convenient heads up display keeps the times front of mind while you continue to use the app.
GROCERY LISTS
Create shopping lists directly from your recipes, easily copy just the ingredients you need to your list. Integrates with Reminders for convenient access. Your groceries have never been easier!
CLOUD SYNCING
All of your recipes are conveniently synced between all of your devices using iCloud. 
RECIPE FEEDS
Save your favourite recipe RSS feeds into Crouton to see new recipes as they’re published from your favourite blogs.
AI IMPORTING
Quickly import recipes using AI. Import a recipe from a single photo with no manual entry required. Also supports plain text and images. 
FAMILY SHARING
Share your recipes with friends and family using iCloud, so everyone knows what’s for dinner.
GUIDED WEIGHING
Pair to supported Bluetooth scales (such as the Acaia coffee scales) and have Crouton guide you through weighing your ingredients, avoid the mental juggling of recipe steps and amounts
COMBUSTION PROBE SUPPORT
Crouton pairs with Combustion's temperature prove to provide live updates on your cook
Crouton also offers a range of customization including custom icons and app colors.

apple-macos:403304796.name: iNet Network Scanner
apple-macos:403304796.description:
iNet – Know Your Network.
See at a glance what’s happening on your network.
Which devices are connected to your Wi-Fi? Are there any devices you don’t recognize? What services are running? iNet gives you a clear overview of your local network and the tools for a closer look.
Whether at home or as a network professional, iNet lets you scan your network, identify connected devices, discover active services and open ports, and wake Macs, PCs, and other devices remotely.
Give your devices custom names and icons so you can recognize them instantly the next time you scan your network.
Network Scanner
• Find all devices on your network
• View IP and MAC addresses and other device information
• Assign custom names and icons to easily identify devices
• Set IP scan ranges and select network interfaces
• Export scan results as CSV or PDF
• Connect directly via SSH, VNC, HTTP, and more
Bonjour Monitor
• Monitor Bonjour services in real time
• See which services are available on each device
• View detailed information about services and domains
Wake on LAN
• Wake Macs, PCs, and other compatible devices over LAN or the Internet
• Put Macs to sleep, shut them down, or restart them remotely
• Execute SSH commands
• Save frequently used devices as favorites
AirPort Monitor
Keep an eye on compatible Apple AirPort base stations directly from iNet.
• View AirPort base station status in real time•
 Monitor network traffic and Wi-Fi quality live
• Check signal strength for individual devices
• View detailed information about your AirPort base station
Note: Newer 802.11ac AirPort models are not supported because Apple removed SNMP support from these models.
Help & Documentation
• Built-in help in English and German
• Glossary explaining important networking terms
Privacy Included. Your network data stays with you.
iNet collects no user data and requires no account or sign-in. There are no subscriptions or recurring fees. Buy iNet once — future updates are included.
Developed and maintained in Germany since 2010.
iNet is also available for iPhone and iPad.

flathub:org.jitsi.jitsi-meet.name: Jitsi Meet
flathub:org.jitsi.jitsi-meet.summary: Jitsi Meet - Secure, Simple and Scalable Video Conferences
flathub:org.jitsi.jitsi-meet.description:
Jitsi Meet lets you stay in touch with all your teams, be they family, friends, or colleagues. Instant video conferences, efficiently adapting to your scale.
 Works with any Jitsi deployment.
 Unlimited users: There are no artificial restrictions on the number of users or conference participants. Server power and bandwidth are the only limiting factors.
 No account needed.
 Lock-protected rooms: Control the access to your conferences with a password.
 Encrypted by default.
 Experimental End-to-End Encryption support for further enhanced security.
 High quality: Audio and video are delivered with the clarity and richness of Opus, VP8, VP9, AV1.
 Web browser ready: No downloads are required of your friends to join the conversation. Jitsi Meet works directly within their browsers as well. Simply share your conference URL with others to get started.
 100% open source: Powered by awesome communities from all over the world. And your friends at 8x8.
 Invite by pretty URLs: You can meet at the easy to remember https://MySite.com/OurConf of your choice instead of joining the hard to remember rooms with seemingly random sequences of numbers and letters in their names.
 Support for jitsi-meet:// URLs, for linking directly to conversations.

fedora-packages:environment-modules/envi.name: environment-modules
fedora-packages:environment-modules/envi.summary: Provides dynamic modification of a user's environment
fedora-packages:environment-modules/envi.description: The Environment Modules package provides for the dynamic modification of a user's environment via modulefiles. Each modulefile contains the information needed to configure the shell for an application. Once the Modules package is initialized, the environment can be modified on a per-module basis using the module command which interprets modulefiles. Typically modulefiles instruct the module command to alter or set shell environment variables such as PATH, MANPATH, etc. modulefiles may be shared by many users on a system and users may have their own collection to supplement or replace the shared modulefiles. Modules can be loaded and unloaded dynamically and atomically, in an clean fashion. All popular shells are supported, including bash, ksh, zsh, sh, csh, tcsh, as well as some scripting languages such as perl. Modules are useful in managing different versions of applications. Modules can also be bundled into meta-modules that will load an entire suite of different applications. NOTE: You will need to get a new shell after installing this package to have access to the module alias.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-edim/gap-pkg-edi.name: gap-pkg-edim

The programs are developed and already successfully used for large matrices (up to rank >12000) with moderate entries and many non-trivial elementary divisors which are products of some small primes. But they should be useful for other types of matrices as well. Among the other functions of the package are: - an inversion algorithm for large rational matrices (using a p-adic method) - a program for finding the largest elementary divisor of an integral matrix (particularly interesting when this is much smaller than the determinant) and - implementations of some normal form algorithms described by Havas, Majewski, Matthews, Sterling (using LLL- or modular techniques).

fedora-packages:ghc-tf-random/ghc-tf-ran.name: ghc-tf-random
fedora-packages:ghc-tf-random/ghc-tf-ran.description: This package contains an implementation of a high-quality splittable pseudorandom number generator. The generator is based on a cryptographic hash function built on top of the ThreeFish block cipher. See the paper /Splittable Pseudorandom Number Generators Using Cryptographic Hashing/ by Claessen, Pałka for details and the rationale of the design. The package provides the following: * A splittable PRNG that implements the standard 'System.Random.RandomGen' class. * The generator also implements an alternative version of the 'System.Random.TF.Gen.RandomGen' class (exported from "System.Random.TF.Gen"), which requires the generator to return pseudorandom integers from the full 32-bit range, and contains an n-way split function. * An alternative version of the 'Random' class is provided, which is linked to the new 'RandomGen' class, together with 'Random' instances for some integral types. * Two functions for initialising the generator with a non-deterministic seed: one using the system time, and one using the '/dev/urandom' UNIX special file. The package uses an adapted version of the reference C implementation of ThreeFish from the reference package of the Skein hash function (<https://www.schneier.com/skein.html>), originally written by Doug Whiting. Please note that even though the generator provides very high-quality pseudorandom numbers, it has not been designed with cryptographic applications in mind.

Using our Amazon Discount Finder takes less than a minute for instant results. First, select the country you live in or wish to buy from, and enter the product name you'd normally type in the Amazon search bar.
Next, select the department that best describes your search, and use the Discount Range sliders to select what kind of discount you want to search for.
You can then pick from a range of different deal types, such as Today's Deals, Free Shipping Deals, or Prime Deals, by clicking on the appropriate boxes in the Deal Types section, before entering your desired price range in the boxes provided.
Finally, you can customize results and press "Search Discount" and get the deals you're looking for.
Click on the filters you wish to apply and then click the Search button to proceed.
✨ How to Use Amazon Gift Finder? 
Using our Amazon Gift Finder to find great gifts for your friends and family couldn't be easier. To begin, simply choose the target age group of the person you want to buy for, which could be an adult, teen, or child.

You can then apply filters to include products that are currently involved in deals or can be gift-wrapped.
You'll then be able to pick from any of Amazon's many product categories, like Travel, Home & Garden, Tech & Gadgets, and Geeky, to narrow down your search. Choose as many or as few categories as you like, and click on the Search Gift button to begin your search.

Using Amazon Best Sellers to find the latest top-selling products on Amazon is super simple. To get started, all you need to do is enter a search term into the box provided. For best results, we recommend entering generic terms like "running shoes" or "headphones" instead of brand names.
The Best Sellers tool will then present you with a list of categories corresponding to your search. For example, for "running shoes", you'll see categories like "Boys Running Shoes" and "Men's Trail Running Shoes". You can scroll through and click on whichever one you want to see the best-sellers for.
Alternatively, you can click on one of the categories listed in the "Most popular best sellers categories" section, underneath the search bar. This section contains some of the most popular categories that users have been searching for on Amazon.
Once you click on a category, the Best Sellers page will redirect you directly to the Amazon Best Sellers page for your chosen category. There, you'll be able to see the 100 most-ordered products from that selection.

bluejetty:00042631:ios.name: OP TCG Dex: Card Scanner
bluejetty:00042631:ios.summary: OP TCG Dex is the complete OP TCG companion app and trading card database app for players, collectors, traders, and deck builders. Search cards fast, scan cards instantly, build decks, track collection, organize vaults and check card prices
bluejetty:00042631:ios.description:
OP TCG Dex is the complete OP TCG companion app and trading card database app for players, collectors, traders, and deck builders. Search cards fast, scan cards instantly, build decks, track collection, organize vaults and check card prices.
SEARCH, FILTER, AND FIND ANY CARD
Use our fast and comprehensive card search to find cards by name, card number, set, color, cost, power, counter, rarity, type, and more. Browse the full card list and card index, filter by card rarity and card sets, and sort results for deck building. Whether you need card lookup, TCG card lookup, or card database access, every card is easy to find.
CARD SCANNER APP FOR COLLECTION AND BATTLE PREP
Use the built-in card scanner app and trading card scanner to speed up collection updates, deck checks, and match preparation. Card scan and card recognition help you scan card collection entries faster, scan card prices during trades, and scan cards into your inventory. Card scan to collection is optimized for repeat use so you can process large binders faster.
COMPLETE CARD DATABASE AND CARD EFFECTS
Access a robust card database with English and Japanese card text, trigger effects, card effects, and TCG english translation support where available. Review card market price, card value, card worth, and card trends while comparing English, Japanese, French designs. Use the app as your card effect reference app before and during games.
DECK BUILDER, META DECKS, AND TOURNAMENT LISTS
Build, edit, and save multiple OP Card Game decks in one place. Create meta deck lists, tournament deck builds with deck builder and deck manager. Import decklist ideas - use deck import tools, build deck plans faster, and track deck stats over time with OP TCG Dex.
COLLECTION TRACKER, INVENTORY, AND ORGANIZER
Track owned cards with this card collection app/card collector app. Manage and organize your card inventory. Know what you own before buying, trading, or building across English and Japanese versions.
DIGITAL VAULTS AND DECK BOX TRACKER
Track owned cards in a clean digital collection so you always know what you have before buying, trading, or building. Organize where cards are stored across binders, deck boxes, tins, and other vaults. Reduce duplicate purchases, speed up deck assembly, and manage your inventory confidently.
PRICE TRACKER AND TCG PRICES
Check up-to-date TCG prices with a practical price tracker for trades, purchases, and collection growth. Monitor card prices, card value changes, and market movement while deck building with OP.TCG Dex.
TCG TOOLS, ASSISTANT, AND COMPANION FEATURES
OP TCG Dex works as a TCG companion app and TCG assistant for daily play. Use TCG tools for search, scanning, deck building, collection tracking, and prep.
OFFLINE BATTLE MODE WITH FRIENDS
Use offline battle support: choose your deck, scan your opponent's deck, lay out cards, and reference card effects in English during games with a practical card simulator style layout.
WHY PLAYERS USE OPTCG DEX DAILY
- Fast card search and card checker flow for deck edits between rounds
- Reliable deck builder app for brewing, testing, and tournament prep
- Practical card scanner app for collection updates and trade checks
- Card collection tracker, card inventory manager, and card organizer in one place
- Helpful price tracker and TCG prices view for buying and trading decisions
- Card database, card filter, and card list tools built for real players
PRO FEATURES FOR POWER USERS
- Expand base deck and vault limits up to 50 each
- Unlimited card scanning for heavy users and large collections
- Currency converter for clearer price comparisons
- Notes on cards and decks
- Deck statistics and charts
- Ad-free experience
OP TCG Dex helps you build better decks, manage your collection, and play with confidence. Download now and level up your OP Card Game experience.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://optcgdex.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://optcgdex.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00066257:ios.name: Rope Hero 2
bluejetty:00066257:ios.summary: Welcome to the city of heroes. Your stylish hero in a protective SCI-FI suit is ready to act. A third-person action game in a big city awaits you. The game location is full of dangerous and exciting adventures. Plunge into the open 3D world
bluejetty:00066257:ios.description:
Welcome to the city of heroes. Your stylish hero in a protective SCI-FI suit is ready to act. A third-person action game in a big city awaits you. The game location is full of dangerous and exciting adventures. Plunge into the open 3D world with your hero and fight with gangsters. You have to act in a modern metropolis. The city map is open from the very beginning, this will allow you to visit anywhere in the city. The city hides a large number of secrets and mini-games. Explore the urban jungle, discover interesting places for you and find out what is happening there. For example, at a military base, you can get ammo, weapons, a first-aid kit, or unique military equipment for you. The game has cool guns, beautiful cars, realistic physics and much more. To fight against bandits, your man will have superpowers. It's time to become a superhero. It's time to become strong, fast and hardy.
The game world is full of various dangers. Street gangs engaged in illegal activities flooded the city streets. Thieves and killers will lie in wait for you at every turn. Corrupt police will interfere with your confrontation. The harsh city streets will not let you relax. Here you can easily be robbed or beaten. Beware of street gangs in the alleys if you are not ready for the confrontation.
The main mission of your hero is to infiltrate an underground empire. To do this, you need to complete tasks in order to understand how the criminal world works. Fight petty crime and car thieves. Earn game resources to spend them on the purchase of necessary things. When you realize that you’ve fully figured out in the city, act like a superhero. Eliminate all the bandits and the rest of the evil that has enveloped this city.
If you get tired of the intense action, you can always calmly explore the city in a car with good music. The game features beautiful sports cars and a large list of radio stations. Ride to interesting places.
Take your daily rewards. Come and get rewards every day and get the main prize for free. In the game, you can always replenish the supply of crystals by receiving them for free several times a day.
When passing the game, your hero will receive a level that depends on the gaming experience. The hero's skill grows in the direction with which you interact most.
Get game achievements and resources for them. Description of achievements you will find in the game menu. Get all the achievements and unlock a valuable prize.
Customize your character, equip your hero with the best that the game gives. In the game store you will find various skins for your hero. Each skin has its own set of boosts. You will be able to collect a unique skin for your hero by creating it from spare parts from other costumes. Learn the parameters of costumes and choose only the best for your hero.
The game has interesting 3D graphics. Improved lighting and visual effects. All this, together with good optimization, will allow you to enjoy the game on both a weak device and a powerful one.
Your hero can have the maximum set of superpowers. Some of your hero’s abilities are unlimited and always available. Other abilities you can buy in the heroes store.
Flying - will allow you to become even cooler. Since you can fly anywhere in the city whenever you want.
Super rope is the basic ability of a superhero, it is infinite, with its help the hero can fly between buildings and climb like a climber.
Super Jumps - Super jumps and flying allow you to quickly move around the city, dodge enemies and do other interesting things.
In difficult fights with enemies, the superhero's abilities may not be enough. For this, the game has a weapons store. You can buy everything you need.
In the game a large number of vehicles you can ride on any of them. Get equipment and keep it in your garage.
You can find or buy a tank and be safe.
Become an urban legend. The city is waiting for you. Take advantage of the superhero to the maximum.

bluejetty:00041496:ios.description:
New free to play puzzles and mini games of Maze Of Realities: Reflection Of Light! These games have no plot differences with the original puzzle, and its main feature is that you can find hidden objects and play the entire quest for free!
A mysterious meteorite has crashed in the Grand Canyon, Arizona. Archaeologists rush there to examine the space rock, but an entire team goes missing. You and your niece, Emma, are members of a search party. You arrive at the deserted camp to look for some clues, and suddenly, the meteorite teleports you to another universe! Now you must explore the fascinating Worlds of Light and Shadow, look for hidden artifacts, and solve puzzles to find the archaeologists. And you'll surely get help on your adventure, but remember the most important thing – not all friendly strangers can actually be your friends!
· SAVE THE WORLDS OF LIGHT AND SHADOW FROM COMPLETE ANNIHILATION IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play more exciting puzzles after you finish the main story! More collectibles are waiting for you in this unique chapter, where you can find hidden objects and unlock all new branches of the story!
· GATHER COLLECTIBLES AND LOOK FOR MORPHING OBJECTS!
Each location has a unique collection of various collectibles to help you in your investigation! Are you ready to go on an exciting adventure and collect all the artifacts while playing hidden object games?
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE CONCEPT ART AND MUSIC!
Our games have tons of bonus content for you to enjoy! More hidden pictures needed to be found in our games!
· REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE HIDDEN-OBJECT GAMES AND MINI-GAMES TO UNLOCK CHALLENGING ACHIEVEMENTS!
Replay your favorite games to earn as many achievements as you can to brag to your friends!
Download one of the most amazing games – Maze Of Realities: Reflection Of Light! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

- Oval
- Square
- Round
- Heart 
- Oblong
- Diamond
Choose your face shape and find the best hairstyles that suits you. Download now and enjoy!

Play a growing world of quirky, joyful indie games.
Discover, play and support games made by independent creators from around the world... and create your own!
Play and help shape the next indie gem:
- Unlimited indie games instantly in-app, no install needed
- Sharing feedback with creators
- Explore new games every week, from around the world
Every game in the app was built with GDevelop: the no-code and AI powered, open-source game engine used by thousands of creators, artists, and independent developers.
Start exploring. Play something small. Or weird. Or wonderful.
Create your own games. Or play any game you're dreaming of!
It's fast, easy, and no technical knowledge is required to get started.
Try it, or get a GDevelop subscription to unlock every feature!
- Explore dozens of game templates or start from scratch.
- Use AI to help you build your game step by step.
- Use your own characters, or choose from a library of pre-made objects such as characters, animations, sounds, and music.
- Quickly add pre-made logic to your game objects with GDevelop's Behaviors.
- Write game logic with GDevelop's innovative event system based on "if / then" actions and conditions.
- Publish your game in a few seconds and share it with your friends, colleagues, or customers.
- Allow players to submit their scores with ready-to-use leaderboards or make online multiplayer games.
Dozens of thousands of games are made every month with GDevelop.
Unleash your creativity, and create all kinds of games: platformers, shoot’em up, strategy, 8-bit, or hyper-casual games... the sky is the limit.
GDevelop is a powerful game engine that will transform you into a game designer:
- Add explosions and effects with particles.
- Use visual effects ("shaders").
- Pathfinding and advanced movements (bounce, elliptic movement, screen wrap, projectiles...).
- Advanced rendering engine that can handle pixel-art games, modern 2D games, 2.5D isometric games and 3D games.
- Text objects for scores, dialogues, with optional typewriter effects.
- Transitions and smooth movement for objects.
- Leaderboards and Real-time Multiplayer.
- Platformer engine.
- Realistic 2D and 3D physics engine.
- Sound effects and music handling.
- Ready-to-use objects for your game interface: text input, buttons, joysticks, progress bars...
- Complete documentation available for each feature.
- Dozens of extensions that give new behaviors, new actions, and new conditions: checkpoints, object shaking, 3D flip effects...
GDevelop makes game development easy, even for those with no prior experience.
Download the app and join a community of 400k+ monthly creators: gamers, hobbyists, teachers, and professionals.
GDevelop's unique design makes game creation fast and fun!
Our Terms & Conditions: https://gdevelop.io/page/terms-and-conditions
Our Privacy Policy: https://gdevelop.io/page/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00013664:ios.name: Monkey Stories:Books & Reading
bluejetty:00013664:ios.summary:
Monkey Stories is an English language learning program which aims at helping children be fluent in English before the age of 10 (suitable for children of 2 - 10 years of age).
I. Achievements
Monkey Stories has won many prestigious awards
bluejetty:00013664:ios.description:
Monkey Stories is an English language learning program which aims at helping children be fluent in English before the age of 10 (suitable for children of 2 - 10 years of age).
I. Achievements
Monkey Stories has won many prestigious awards and achievements, leading the way in English learning apps for children.
#1 most downloaded English learning app for kids.
More than 10 million users worldwide.
Users in 108 countries, including English-speaking countries such as the US, UK, Australia and Canada.
Monkey Stories is also developed by the founder of Monkey Junior, the application won the First Prize in the Global Innovation through Science and Technology (GIST) Tech-I Competition chaired by US President Barack Obama.
II. Introduction to Monkey Stories app for iPhone/iPad
1. Targeted users
Monkey Stories is most suitable for children aged 2-10 which helps children develop the four skills of listening, speaking, reading and writing.
2. Objectives
Listening: Fully recognize and understand language heard when communicating with native speakers
Speaking: Standard American English pronunciation and intonation
Reading: Improve your children's reading comprehension and make reading more fun and fulfilling
Writing: Develop accurate writing style, logical flow, word usage, and expression like a native user
3. Why Monkey Stories?
3.1. Help children to immerse themselves in English at home
Access to over 430 audiobooks divided into four levels, diverse genres with selective and educational content.
Access to standardized English voices with diverse features, such as: listening with a timer, audiobooks playing on screensaver, subtitles with each word highlighted in time with the vocal recording,... 
3.2. Master accurate American English pronunciation
Monkey Stories applies Synthetic Phonics - the famous synthetic decoding and blending method used by the Ministry of Education of English-speaking countries around the world. This method helps children to spell words easily, read fluently, write with correct spelling, and boost confidence when communicating in English.
3.3. Broaden social knowledge as well as vocabulary that is often used in everyday life 
The diverse words in Monkey Stories are used to cover many different topics, providing children with a rich and large vocabulary. This is a foundation which children can use to understand and use English flexibly and correctly.
3.4. Learn all four skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing
With just a single application, children can practice all 4 skills of listening, speaking, reading and writing effectively thanks to more than 1,100+ interactive picture stories, 430+ audiobooks...
3.5. Monkey Stories does not affect children’s health
With appropriate learning time and fantastic features like listening with a timer and audiobooks playing on screensaver, kids can learn effectively and minimize the negative impacts on their eyesight, which parents are still worried about when letting their children use applications.
III. Features 
Outstanding features of Monkey Stories:
- High interactivity: listening, watching, reading, touching, and speaking, all of which keep kids active during the lesson.
- Accurate pronunciation evaluation using voice recognition (AI). 
- Effective story classification system by level and topic.
- Subtitles with each word highlighted in time with the vocal recording.
- Post-story activities with attractive graphics.
- Weekly updated content.
- Printable PDF worksheets for children to practice after reading stories or other lessons.
IV. Support
Email: support.global@monkeyenglish.net
Terms of Use: https://www.monkeyenglish.net/en/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.monkeyenglish.net/en/policy

bluejetty:00043555:ios.description:
En Guarde! Time to test your dexterity in skills in the action packed dueling game. You control the sword with your fingertips. Every swipe, slice and stab is based off of your movement. It’s like having a joystick on your phone. Drawing an item and watching it perform next on the screen is old news. This is the next generation of action packed drawing games.
Can you defeat your opponent in the duel? Parry, block, and dance - do whatever it takes to avoid contact. Then you take action and launch your attack! No one can avoid your swift furry. The faster you can move your sword around the more likely you will land a hit! The controls are so smooth you will think you are sword fighting yourself… without the danger!
The pen is finally mightier than the sword. Can you rise to the top and defeat everyone?
 Game Features:
1. Simple but addicting mechanics
Draw in the open space and watch the sword mimic your movement. It’s that simple
2. Amazing Physics
It’s like you are controlling the sword yourself. Sword fighting has never felt more realistic
3. Keep on upgrading!
So many different styles and swords to unlock. Can you become a samurai? 
4. Relax and enjoy
No need to put yourself in danger. Take some swings from your phone. You are in complete control.

bluejetty:00019422:ios.name: Snowboard Party
bluejetty:00019422:ios.summary: Snowboard Party brings the thrill of snowboarding to your mobile device! Get ready to ride the downhill slopes at extreme speed and catch some big air to perform the craziest tricks in 21 completely unique adrenaline-filled mountains/locati
bluejetty:00019422:ios.description:
Snowboard Party brings the thrill of snowboarding to your mobile device! Get ready to ride the downhill slopes at extreme speed and catch some big air to perform the craziest tricks in 21 completely unique adrenaline-filled mountains/locations. Jump on your board, learn new moves and improve your snowboarding skills to land sick freestyle trick combos and rack high scores! Experience snowboarding like never before!
Complete over 105 level objectives, 32 achievements, gain experience and upgrade your favorite snowboarder attributes to perform better and achieve higher scores. Customize your snow gear and upgrade your board to give you an extra edge over the competition. 
HIGH DEFINITION 
Snowboard Party includes next generation 3D sport game graphics specially optimized for your mobile hardware to provide you with the best snowboarding experience.
FREESTYLE 
Freestyle is all about the tricks! Perform the sickest tricks using natural and man-made park features such as rails, ski jumps, boxes, logs, rocks and innumerable other objects! Create new freestyle trick combos to hit higher scores while in the trick parks. 
BIG AIR 
Go big or go home! Big air competitions are contests where riders perform extreme tricks on massive ski jumps while going down the slope at high speed. 
HALFPIPE 
Perform a wide range of tricks while going down some of the world’s biggest halfpipes. Chain multiple tricks in a row to gain more points and achieve a better score. 
QUICK PLAY 
Drop in faster than ever into a curated selection of maps and modes. Challenge yourself with a rotating list of objectives to keep you on your toes. Complete each challenge to continue along your tour of the world’s premiere snowboarding locations. 
MASSIVE SELECTION 
Select between 15 snowboarders and customize each of them to your preference, choosing your favorite gear. A massive collection of boards ranging from different sizes and designs are available, allowing you to complement your rider’s extreme skills and abilities. 
LEARN TO SNOWBOARD
Over 50 unique tricks to master and hundreds of combinations. Follow the tutorial to get started and progress as you go. Execute the craziest combos and extreme trick sequences to rack up some impressive high scores, gain experience and make a name for yourself. 
GAME CONTROLLER
Compatible with most game controllers available. 
CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS 
New fully customizable control system to configure your own button layout. Use the right or left handed control mode, select a control preset or create your own. Use the analog stick or accelerometer option as you wish. 
LOADED WITH FEATURES 
• Supports all the latest generation devices and optimized for high resolution displays.
• Quick Play mode lets you drop in and shred across a curated selection of maps and modes.
• New fully customizable control system. You can adjust everything! 
• Learn over 50 unique tricks and create hundreds of combinations. 
• Massive mountains/locations to ride including 21 trails/courses located in the Rockies, Alps and Japan. Choose from big air, freestyle, and halfpipe events. 
• Customize your outfit in style!
• Upgrade your board to improve your rider’s stats.
• Play often to gain experience and upgrade your favorite snowboarder’s attributes. 
• Share your results with your friends on Twitter. 
• Optimized for Intel x86 mobile devices.
• Extended soundtrack featuring songs from Closer, Jack Counteract, Minds Without Purpose, Mr. TaBoo Timmons, No Blitz, Paul Spencer and the Maxines, Pear, The Pinz and We Outspoken. Courtesy of Pulse Records/White Knight Music Group, Inc.
• Ability to purchase experience points or special items using in-app purchases. 
• Available in the following languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Chinese. 
SUPPORT: contact@maplemedia.io

bluejetty:00014435:ios.description:
Enjoy quick and secure access to your accounts anytime, anywhere. Our Free Online Banking app provides everything you need to manage your finances, pay bills, deposit checks and more.
Account Management 
Easily open additional accounts and view all your balances in one place, including external accounts added from other banks. Stay informed with customizable alerts for deposits, withdrawals, and card purchases. Plus, you can quickly access your statements and important documents right from the app
Card Controls 
Lock or unlock your lost or misplaced debit card or credit card, redeem rewards, and take control of your spending by setting restrictions on where and how your card is used, including by merchant type, transaction type, or spending limits.
Send and Receive Money 
Set up direct deposit right in the app and get paid up to two days early with Free Early Paycheck. Plus, pay bills electronically and easily transfer money between your MIDFLORIDA accounts or to and from accounts you own elsewhere.
Security 
MIDFLORIDA safeguards your financial information from unauthorized users with optional 2-Step Authentication, advanced encryption technology, and one-time passcodes. Plus, you can easily manage and disconnect applications connected to your online banking profile through Plaid at any time, giving you greater control over your account security.
Save and Educate 
Automate your savings with Smart Save, a debit card round-up feature, and manage your finances with our budgeting tools and goal trackers. Plus, access financial literacy courses to enhance your financial knowledge.
Register: 
To use the MIDFLORIDA Mobile App, you must be a member of MIDFLORIDA and enrolled in our Free Online Banking platform. 
Insured by NCUA

bluejetty:00098727:ios.description:
Women's Bible Verse Devotional is your personal sanctuary, thoughtfully designed to offer unwavering spiritual companionship and profound emotional solace to women around the globe. If you're seeking a daily source of comfort, unwavering faith, and inner peace, this app is crafted exclusively for you. It's where your spiritual journey is not just honored, but truly nurtured and enriched every single day.
Immerse Yourself in God's Word:
Dive into the Bible electronic book reading experience, allowing you to explore scriptures at your own pace. Whether you're seeking comfort, wisdom, or understanding, our intuitive interface makes studying the Bible a joyful and enriching part of your daily life.
Personalize Your Study with Notes & Highlights:
Your spiritual journey deserves to be cherished. Take notes at any time to record your thoughts, reflections, and prayers. Highlight meaningful verses so that God's Word takes deeper root in your heart. You can even bookmark your favorite scriptures for easy access, creating a personal devotion journal that witnesses your faith's beautiful growth.
Cultivate Daily Connection Through Prayer & Devotion:
Start and end your day rooted in faith with our unique morning prayer and night prayer reminders. Receive uplifting daily devotional content crafted to resonate with a woman's heart, guiding you through moments of reflection, gratitude, and surrender. Let every sunrise and sunset be an opportunity to draw closer to the divine.
Strengthen Your Faith with Fun Quizzes:
Make learning engaging and memorable! Our interactive quiz feature transforms Bible knowledge into a delightful game. Challenge yourself, reinforce your understanding of scriptures, and enhance your Bible common sense memory in a fun, rewarding way. It’s an innovative path to spiritual growth, blending wisdom with play.
Access Your Faith Anytime, Anywhere – Even Offline:
Your spiritual nourishment should never be interrupted. Enjoy offline access to the Bible and all devotional content, ensuring that the wisdom of God's Word is always available to you, whether you have an internet connection or not.
Women's Bible Verse Devotional is more than just an app—it's a spiritual partner that effortlessly integrates the solace of the Holy Bible into your daily routine. Every single feature is thoughtfully crafted to meet you where you are, empowering, supporting, and guiding you on your faith journey. Download the Bible app today to unlock sacred wisdom and embark on a journey of self-discovery, tailored exclusively for women, leading you towards a richer, more fulfilling spiritual life.

Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/womensbible-service/

bluejetty:00083705:ios.description:
Looking for a powerful and versatile tool to manage your finances? The Interest Calculator app is designed for users from all countries, making it easy to calculate and understand various types of interest on your investments and savings. Whether you're dealing with fixed deposits (FD), certificates of deposit (CD), guaranteed investment certificates (GIC), recurring deposits (RD), or any other investment, this app is your go-to solution.
Key Features:
- Compound & Simple Interest: Calculate both compound and simple interest for accurate financial planning.
- Fixed Deposits (FD): Quickly determine the returns on your fixed deposits with different terms and rates.
- Certificates of Deposit (CD): Analyze your CD investments with ease, including interest rates and future values.
- Guaranteed Investment Certificates (GIC): Get detailed calculations for GICs to plan your future investments.
- Recurring Deposits (RD): Track and calculate the interest on your recurring deposits.
- Investment Analysis: Evaluate different investment options and their potential returns.
- Interest Rates: Input various interest rates to see how they affect your investment or savings.
- Term & Time Calculations: Adjust the term and time period to suit your financial needs.
- Fixed Deposits & Bonds: Comprehensive tools for calculating interest on fixed deposits and bonds.
- Festgeld: Manage your Festgeld investments with precise calculations.
- Future Value: Project the future value of your investments with compound and simple interest calculations.
- Quick & Easy: User-friendly interface for quick and accurate results.
- Bank & Investment Terms: Covers a wide range of bank and investment terms for global users.
Whether you're a seasoned investor or just starting to save, the Interest Calculator app provides the tools you need to make informed financial decisions. Download now and take control of your financial future!

bluejetty:00039192:ios.description:
PROMT.One is an online and offline translator, a dictionary with transcription and phrasebooks .
FREE ONLINE VERSION OPTIONS
- 3-in-1: translator, dictionary and phrasebook
- Speech and text translation in “Dialog” mode 
- Text translation in images and photos
- Voice input and pronunciation
- Roaming traffic saving mode
PREMIUM OFFLINE SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS 
- 7-day free trial period
- ADS FREE app 
- Offline Translator, Phrasebook and Dictionary 
- 7 popular languages are accessible for offline translation: 
English, French, German, Russian, Spanish, Italian, Portugal
- and 20 languages are always accessible online
TRANSLATION IN “DIALOG” MODE
Speech translation in dialog mode allows you to communicate easily at any time and place. Choose the languages for communication, speak your native language and receive a translation of your dialog partner speech.
TRANSLATE IN ANY APP
Just copy the selected text fragment, its translation appears in the notification area. Context menu is also accessible for work with texts in any app for iOS.
PHOTO TRANSLATION
Translation of text directly from camera or from gallery photos. Just select a text fragment or a word at the image.
SPEAK AND LISTEN
It is not necessary to type text, just pronounce a phrase and listen to its translation. It is convenient at the travel abroad and during foreign languages studies!
STUDY LANGUAGES EASILY
Use the app as a full-fledged dictionary containing translations of words from different subjects areas, information about parts of speech and transcription. You also can listen how a word and any of its translations are pronounced.
SAVE ROAMING TRAFFIC
Special mode which allows you to minimize mobile web traffic when you translate during travel abroad. 
TRANSLATION FOR POPULAR LANGUAGES
English, Arabic, Greek, Hebrew, Spanish, Italian, Kazakh, Chinese (simplified), Korean, German, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Finnish, French, Japanese.
Required Permissions:
• Microphone - for speech translation
• Camera – for translation of text from images
Subscription Terms of Use:
https://www.promt.com/mobile/translate/eula/
Did you like our app? We are very glad! Leave a comment about it in App Store and help others to choose our translator. This is the best way to thank us.
Don’t give us a poor mark immediately. If the app didn’t meet your expectations, please contact us at support@promt.com and we will improve the product for your special benefit!

bluejetty:00021907:ios.summary:
Welcome to the adventure of learning by playing!
Kokoro Kids is an educational games application where children learn while having fun with hundreds of games, activities, stories and songs.
Created by experts in early education and neurop
bluejetty:00021907:ios.description:
Welcome to the adventure of learning by playing!
Kokoro Kids is an educational games application where children learn while having fun with hundreds of games, activities, stories and songs.
Created by experts in early education and neuropsychology to help in the emotional and cognitive development of the little ones, based on game-based learning and the theory of multiple intelligences.
The application has hundreds of activities and games that offer a personalized experience at each child's level. With Kokoro's content, they can play instruments, solve challenges, learn to count, learn vocabulary or express their creativity. It is a complement to the curricular activities of the school and perfect to start learning skills for their future. 
Each child learns at his or her own pace, so the games are suitable for all ages, but especially for children in kindergarten and primary school. They are also in 4 languages (Spanish, English, Portuguese, and Bahasa). Children and adults can have fun and learn while playing!
CATEGORIES
Math: activities to learn numbers, geometric shapes, adding, subtracting, sorting, and using logic to solve problems. 
Communication: games to encourage reading, learning vowels and consonants, spelling, and vocabulary activities. 
Brain games: puzzle, find the differences, connect the dotted line, memory, Simon, find objects in the dark. They will improve attention and reasoning. 
Science: STEAM, learn about the human body, animals, and planets and learn how to take care of the oceans. 
Creativity: music games, painting, decorating the most delicious pizzas, customizing your kokoros with costumes and vehicles. He will explore his curiosity and imagination. 
Emotional intelligence: Learn emotions, to name them and to recognize them in others. They will also work on skills such as empathy, cooperation, resilience, and frustration tolerance. 
Multiplayer games: Now you can play as a family and develop skills such as communication, collaboration, patience, or resilience.
Playing with Kokoro, your little one will reinforce skills such as perception, concentration, attention, memory, hand-eye coordination, reasoning and more.
All this while playing!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR
Develop your imagination by designing your own kokoro with super cool costumes and vehicles. They can customize their character and be a bee, a ninja, a policeman, a cook, a dinosaur, or astronaut.
ADAPTIVE LEARNING
The Kokoro method incorporates Artificial Intelligence to assign the most appropriate content at the right time, reinforcing the less developed areas and increasing the difficulty in those in which the child excels, thus creating a tailored learning path.
Children learn as they want, at their own pace and with immediate feedback on their results. The main objective is to teach and keep the child motivated by always offering challenging and achievable activities.
KIDS SAFE
Kokoro Kids has been developed with several security protocols to guarantee our children's stay in a safe environment, without inappropriate content and without ads.
DISCOVER YOUR CHILD'S PROGRESS
You can stay on top of your child's needs whenever you want. We have designed a parent dashboard just for you. Find out what your child is achieving and quickly detect those areas where he or she needs more help.
RECOGNITION AND AWARDS
Best Game Beyond entertainment (Game Connection Awards)
Certificate of educational quality (Educational App Store)
Best mobile game (Valencia Indie Awards)
Smart Media (Academics’ choice award-winning)
Kokoro Kids is an educational solution by Apolo Kids, creators of inclusive experiences, for the cognitive and emotional development of children.
Always a pleasure to hear from you! If you have any comments or questions, write to us at: support@kokorokids.app
Terms of Use (Eula) https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms and Conditions https://kokorokids.app/en/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00093027:ios.description:
The Compass Connect™ App brings Smart Home convenience to your RV, allowing you to easily manage and customize key devices, systems and features:
• Make custom Modes for personalized device lists by trip stage.
• Select Favorites for quick access to commonly used devices.
• Extend and Retract Slides and Awnings. 
• Monitor battery and water levels.
• Create Checklists for trip planning and maintenance.
• Use Dark Mode for enhanced readability.
For compatible RVs, enjoy additional features:
• Leveling: Active bubble level, custom setpoints and Auto-Level.
• Automatic generator control for on/off scheduling.
• Customizable lighting for Dimming or RGB lights.
• Remotely control select devices with ConnectAnywhere™ 2.0 and a Telematics plan.
• Track RV Mileage with the Anti-lock Braking system’s digital odometer
Add aftermarket accessories to enhance your RV experience:
• TPMS: Monitor tire health.
• Liquid Propane Sensors: Monitor tank levels.
• Temperature Sensors: Keep an eye on food safety.
• Smart Door Locks: Secure your RV.
Check your RV’s compatibility and visit the Lippert™ store for accessories and Telematics plans. Bluetooth® or WiFi is required for operation.

bluejetty:00022497:ios.name: Twilight Struggle
bluejetty:00022497:ios.summary:
"Now the trumpet summons us again, not as a call to bear arms, though arms we need; not as a call to battle, though embattled we are – but a call to bear the burden of a long twilight struggle..." – President John F. Kennedy
HISTORY IN THE
bluejetty:00022497:ios.description:
"Now the trumpet summons us again, not as a call to bear arms, though arms we need; not as a call to battle, though embattled we are – but a call to bear the burden of a long twilight struggle..." – President John F. Kennedy
HISTORY IN THE MAKING 
Twilight Struggle puts the player at the center of the Cold War, the political and economic struggle between the U.S. and the U.S.S.R that spanned 5 decades from the 1950's to the 1990's. Designed by award winning creators Ananda Gupta and Jason Matthews, players control one of the two modern superpowers, as they work to spread their dominance throughout the world via political influence and coup attempts. But if either side triggers nuclear war, it's game over!
CARD BASED EVENTS 
The event cards in the game are based on actual historical events from the Cold War era. Through the playing of these events, players exert their superpower's influence as they attempt to gain allies and regional control of the globe. From the early days of De-Stalinization, to the Cuban Missile Crisis, the Vietnam War and beyond, players are immersed in the actual events of the struggle between these two nations to be the dominant superpower in the world!
IMMERSIVE STRATEGY 
Hone your skill and strategy as a world leader against an A.I. opponent, and then take your game global with matches against other players via asynchronous online game play. 
FEATURES
•A.I. Opponent 
•In-game Tutorial
•Pass-and-Play Multiplayer
•Asynchronous or Real-time Online Play
•Invite Playdek Friends
•Online Profile and Stats
•Customized Online Game Clock
•Player Rating System 
"As a strategy game, Twilight Struggle is a revelation." - PC Gamer 
"...every strategy gamer should play Twilight Struggle without fail: it's just that good." - Pocket Tactics 
AWARDS 
2012 Ludoteca Ideale Winner 
2011 Lucca Games Best Boardgame for Experts 
2006 International Gamers Awards - Historical Simulation 
2006 International Gamers Awards - General Strategy; Two-players 
2006 Golden Geek Best Wargame Winner 
2006 Golden Geek Best 2-Player Board Game Winner 
2005 James F. Dunnigan Award Winner 
2005 Charles S. Roberts Best Modern Era Boardgame Winner 
*AN INTERNET CONNECTION AND PLAYDEK ACCOUNT ARE REQUIRED FOR ONLINE PLAY.* 
Per our Terms of Service, you must be 13 years old or older to use the Playdek online games service. 
For Twilight Struggle game support, please contact: support@playdekgames.com

bluejetty:00087699:ios.description:
Set the alarm time in just two seconds.
This simple alarm clock app has been designed for maximum ease of use.
Set your favorite music as your alarm and wake up happy!
ALARM FUNCTIONS:
- Snooze (3 - 30 minutes)
- Vibration
- Fade in alarm
OTHER FEATURES:
- Sleep timer (sleep music)
- 12 hour and 24 hour time format
- Vertical and horizontal modes
MORNING:
Use music of your choice or select one of the preset alarms to wake up happy and smiling.
EVENING:
Relax and fall asleep to the sound of your favorite song or one of the preset sleep music.
APP FEATURES:
Unique and intuitive interface is easy to use: launch the app and have your alarm ready in just two seconds.
WHY WE DEVELOPED THIS APP:
There are many alarm clock apps found on the App Store today.
However, most of these require the user to tap through numerous screens just to set an alarm.
Also, most of these apps use a built-in widget for the interface, making it hard to interact with them intuitively.
If you find yourself regularly changing your alarm time, the existing apps out there are a real pain.
That's why we developed this new app, which uses an analog clock for inspiration.

Whether you are a pastor preparing a sermon, a student in a Bible class
bluejetty:00071401:ios.description:
Bible Maps: Scripture Atlas is the most complete biblical map reference app for iPhone and iPad, featuring over 182 full-color maps covering the Old and New Testament.
Whether you are a pastor preparing a sermon, a student in a Bible class, or a believer deepening your faith, this app puts the entire biblical world at your fingertips.
WHAT YOU GET:
- 182 biblical maps of the Old and New Testament
- Physical geography of the Holy Land and ancient Palestine
- The journeys of Abraham, Moses, and the Exodus from Egypt
- The missionary travels of the Apostle Paul
- Division of the Promised Land among the twelve tribes
- Satellite views of biblical routes and territories
- Distance and travel context for each journey
- Full zoom support — pinch to zoom up to 5x
- Bilingual support: English and Spanish
- Offline access after first load
- Favorites — save your most-used maps
- Personal notes on any map
- Built-in biblical timeline by historical era
- Quiz mode to test your biblical geography knowledge
- Share any map with one tap
PERFECT FOR:
Pastors, Sunday school teachers, seminary students, Bible study groups, missionaries, and anyone who wants to understand where biblical events happened and why they matter.
Understanding the geography of the Bible changes how you read it. Knowing how far Abraham traveled, where the tribes settled, or the routes Paul walked makes Scripture come alive in a completely new way.
Download Bible Maps: Scripture Atlas and explore the biblical world today.

bluejetty:00105004:android.name: Junkyard Tycoon: Car Dealer
bluejetty:00105004:android.summary:
Ready to turn rust into riches? Build an automotive empire by buying junk cars, salvaging valuable parts, and selling restored vehicles for massive profit. Transform wrecks into cash in the ultimate car business tycoon simulator!
🚗 BUILD Y
bluejetty:00105004:android.description:
Ready to turn rust into riches? Build an automotive empire by buying junk cars, salvaging valuable parts, and selling restored vehicles for massive profit. Transform wrecks into cash in the ultimate car business tycoon simulator!
🚗 BUILD YOUR JUNKYARD EMPIRE 🏭
Start from nothing and build the most profitable car salvage business. Expand your junkyard, unlock dismantling stations, and grow from a small scrapyard into a multi-million dollar automotive empire!
✔️ Expand with parking slots and ramp stations
✔️ Unlock diagnostic scanners and advanced equipment
✔️ Construct factories: Brick, Concrete, Forestry, Stone Quarry
✔️ Progress from scrapyard to premier dealership
🔧 DISMANTLE & SALVAGE VEHICLES 💰
Buy junk cars when the transporter arrives. Strip each car for valuable parts like engines, battery, rims, brakes, glass, doors, and transmissions. Crush scrap metal for recycling profits or repair vehicles for premium prices!
✔️ Dismantle cars to extract authentic automotive parts
✔️ Discover hidden materials and valuable illegal items
✔️ Use Vehicle Press to compress parts for 2-3x value
✔️ Sell parts individually or restore complete vehicles
⚙️ EARN WHILE OFFLINE - IDLE INCOME 💵
Build passive income systems that work when you're not playing! The Oasis generates money every hour, factories continue production, and energy regenerates automatically.
✔️ Collect offline earnings when you return
✔️ Oasis provides steady passive income
✔️ Auto-sell premium feature sells vehicles while away
✔️ Queue factory production to complete offline
🔨 REPAIR WITH DIAGNOSTIC SCANNER 🏆
Use the Diagnostic Scanner to identify damaged parts. Repair using materials collected from dismantling. Restored vehicles sell for maximum profit in your showroom!
✔️ Scan vehicles to find damaged parts
✔️ Repair engines, battery, rims, brakes, glass
✔️ Restored parts increase value by 50-100%
✔️ Speed up repairs with diamonds
🏭 FACTORIES & PRODUCTION
Construct four specialized factories. Hire employees for production bonuses and install equipment to maximize output!
✔️ Produce bricks, concrete, lumber, stone
✔️ Hire workers for automation bonuses
✔️ Upgrade factories for faster production
💎 LEVEL UP & REWARDS
Progress through 99+ levels. Each level unlocks new vehicles, buildings, and abilities. Earn money, energy, and diamonds!
✔️ Unlock new vehicle types as you level
✔️ Develop company skills for passive bonuses
✔️ Complete 100+ achievements for rewards
🎮 MINI-GAMES FOR INCOME
Earn extra money through mini-games! Compete in drag racing, lap racing, arena challenges, and casino slot machines.
✔️ Drag Racing and Lap Racing with your vehicles
✔️ Arena combat tournaments
✔️ Casino slot machines for jackpots
📊 ADVANCED SYSTEMS
Master the stock market, track transactions through banking system, and manage three currencies (Money, Diamonds, Casino Coins).
✔️ Stock Market for investing profits
✔️ Banking System tracks all transactions
✔️ Multiple save slots for different strategies
✔️ Dynamic pricing based on vehicle condition
🎯 WHY JUNKYARD TYCOON
Perfect for car enthusiasts, business simulation fans, and idle game lovers! Control every aspect of the junkyard business with deep mechanics and satisfying progression. Master vehicle evaluation, optimize factory production, and build your automotive empire!
Play offline anytime - no internet required! Easy one-hand controls, quick 5-15 minute sessions, and rewarding idle mechanics let you earn money even when you're not playing.
Whether you're a simulation veteran or new to tycoon games, Junkyard Tycoon delivers addictive gameplay. Buy low, dismantle smart, repair strategically, sell high!
🏁 START YOUR EMPIRE TODAY
From dusty scrapyard to automotive tycoon - download Junkyard Tycoon and turn junk cars into massive profits. Build factories, master dismantling, automate production, and dominate the car salvage industry!
Download now and start your journey from scrap to empire! 🚗💰

bluejetty:00070343:ios.description:
Math & Brain Games for Kids — MathMinds
- Fun, Educational & Engaging
MathMinds makes learning fun with interactive math and brain games for kids. From counting and basic arithmetic to fractions, decimals, memory, concentration, and puzzles, kids can learn, practice, and progress at their own pace.
No Ads • Offline Play • No Wi-Fi Required
- Learn & Practice Math
Explore:
* Counting
* Addition & Subtraction
* Multiplication & Division
* Fractions & Decimals
* Comparing Numbers
* Shapes & Sorting
* Matching & Memory
* Schulte
* Concentration
* Puzzles
- Practice at Your Level
Beginner — Ages 4–6
Intermediate — Ages 7–9
Advanced — Ages 10+
Kids can learn at their own pace and take on challenges that match their abilities.
- Daily Points & Leaderboard
Kids earn points by playing and answering questions correctly. They can track their progress and compare scores on the World, Country, and Friends Leaderboards.
Points encourage regular practice, accuracy, and making learning a fun daily habit.
- Collect Fun Characters
Kids can collect fun characters as they play and progress. Character collecting adds a creative and relaxing activity, giving kids something exciting to work toward.
- Math & Brain Games in One App
Looking for cool math games for kids that make learning feel like play? MathMinds combines math practice with memory, concentration, matching, puzzles, and other brain games.
Kids can practice mathematical thinking, memory, concentration, attention, logical thinking, problem-solving, accuracy, and perseverance while they play.
Learn, practice, play, and have fun with MathMinds!
- Subscription
A subscription provides unlimited access to all available content. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription through your Apple Account subscription settings.

bluejetty:00043817:ios.description:
The best learning companion for your child's screen-time, after you.
SCREEN-TIME ALIGNED WITH PEDIATRIC RECOMMENDATIONS
Pediatricians recommend co-viewing to improve quality of screen-time. Kidzovo offers a digital learning buddy when you're not around to make sure screen-time remains high quality. It combines high-quality, age-appropriate content from 50+ top creators (like Vooks, SciShow Kids, Kids Learning Tube) with interactive activities to create a play-and-learn experience that feels like a real teacher or friend guiding your child. Say YES to ABCs, 123s, math, science, STEM, phonics, reading, shapes, social skills, coloring, painting, puzzles, all in one app!
OVO: YOUR CHILD'S AI LEARNING BUDDY
Ovo is your child’s personalized co-viewing companion! Ovo greets kids by their name, asks questions like “How was your day?”, and engages them with learning games while watching their favorite content to help reinforce & retain the content better. It uses learning games where kids identify, tap, speak, answer, color, solve puzzles, and more! While Ovo personalizes the experience for your child, they get to personalize Ovo with hats, scarfs, and other accessories as they learn and grow.Every activity builds:
- Fine & gross motor skills (coloring, tapping)
- Language & speech development (voice responses)

RheumaHelper is a pocket rheumatology assistant. Classification criteria, disease activity calculators, and everyday clinical tools — always with you, easy to use, and ready when you need th
bluejetty:00085808:ios.description:
** An awarded mobile tool for rheumatologists **
RheumaHelper is a pocket rheumatology assistant. Classification criteria, disease activity calculators, and everyday clinical tools — always with you, easy to use, and ready when you need them. Designed for iOS 26 with Liquid Glass on iPhone and iPad.
** Verified content **
Reviewed by Prof. Matija Tomšič, M.D., Ph.D., Asst. Prof. Žiga Rotar, M.D., Ph.D. (rheumatologists at University Medical Centre Ljubljana, Slovenia), and Rok Ješe, M.D., Ph.D. (rheumatologist and medical advisor at Mediately). All calculators and criteria are based on referenced equations. References are available inside the app.
** Available tools **
More than 40 tools with fast search access.
Classification criteria:
• Adult Still's disease (Cush, Fautrel, Yamaguchi)
• Antiphospholipid syndrome
• Arthralgia suspicious for progression to RA (2016 EULAR)
• Autoinflammatory recurrent fevers (clinical classification)
• Axial spondyloarthritis
• Behçet's Disease (ICBD)
• Fibromyalgia (2016 ACR)
• Gout (2014 Oxford; 2015 ACR-EULAR)
• IgG4-related disease (2019 ACR/EULAR)
• Idiopathic inflammatory myopathies (2017 ACR/EULAR)
• Inflammatory Back Pain
• Peripheral spondyloarthritis
• Polymyalgia rheumatica
• Primary Sjögren's syndrome (2016 ACR/EULAR)
• Psoriatic arthritis (CASPAR)
• Rheumatoid arthritis (2010 ACR/EULAR)
• Systemic lupus erythematosus (ACR, SLICC, 2019 EULAR/ACR)
• Systemic sclerosis (ACR/EULAR)
• …and more
Disease activity calculators:
• ASDAS — Ankylosing spondylitis disease activity score
• BASDAI — Bath ankylosing spondylitis disease activity index
• BVAS — Birmingham vasculitis activity score (v3)
• DAPSA, DAPSA28
• DAS28
• ESSDAI, ESSPRI
• Five-Factor Score
• PASI — Psoriasis area and severity index
• SDAI / CDAI
• SELENA-SLEDAI
• VDI — Vasculitis damage index
• …and more
General tools:
• QTc (Corrected QT Interval)
• Creatinine Clearance (Cockcroft–Gault)
• eGFR (CKD-EPI and MDRD)
• …and more coming soon
