bluejetty:00087318:ios.summary: FollowMee GPS Tracker converts your iPhone or iPad into a GPS tracking device. Installing this app to the device that you want to track, you can monitor its whereabouts on the FollowMee.com web site. Using this app,  you can track your fami
bluejetty:00087318:ios.description:
FollowMee GPS Tracker converts your iPhone or iPad into a GPS tracking device. Installing this app to the device that you want to track, you can monitor its whereabouts on the FollowMee.com web site. Using this app,  you can track your family members, company devices, or even your employees.
► Location Monitor 
Simply login to the FollowMee.com web site with your desktop or mobile browser. You can view last known location for free. Geofencing, location reporting, location sharing, and other tracking services are available on the web site.
► Data Privacy
We don't serve ad in this mobile app or on the FollowMee.com web site. We don't share your data with outside parties.
► Always On 
Once the app starts, it runs quietly in the background and requires no human interaction. It will restart itself after reboots, or terminated by the phone user. It only stops when the stop button is pressed.
► Configurable App Settings
You can configure tracking power, tracking schedule, or even a password protected lock screen. Business users can use MDM to deploy this app and its settings to the remote devices.
► Tracking Multiple Devices
You can track multiple devices in your account, including devices of other mobile platforms. All your devices are shown on the same map.
► Multiple Mobile Platforms 
Apps for other mobile platforms are available on the FollowMee.com web site.
► No-Internet Contingency 
Cellular or Wifi connection is required to upload location data to the FollowMee server. When connection is interrupted, the app continue to track and data is saved in the device storage. When connection resumes, data is then uploaded. After that, your map will show up-to-date data.
► SOS Panic Button 
Email your current location and call a designated telephone number through cellular (for iPhone) or VOIP (for iPad or iPod Touch).
SIDE NOTE 
► Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00072988:ios.description:
This is a fun and challenging way to test your intelligence. With our IQ test, you can see how well you can think, solve problems, and understand new ideas. You'll be asked a lot of questions, ranging from math problems to puzzles.
Once you've completed the IQ test, you'll receive an IQ score that tells you how well you did. This score can help you understand how smart you are compared to others who have taken the test. People who score high on the test are thought to be really smart.
Our IQ test app provides a great opportunity to challenge yourself and improve your cognitive abilities. Download our app today and see how well you do on our IQ test!
Features:
- Check your answers
- Get a Certificate
- Global Leaderboard
How does it work?
You have 30 minutes to answer 39 questions. The level of difficulty of the questions increases gradually. If you find two logical answers to one question you should choose the simplest answer. You are not rewarded for finishing before time is up - so take your time! Wrong answers do not influence your result - so guess rather than omit a question!
Good luck with the test, and share your IQ with us!

· Gorgeous writing space
· Silky-smooth typing
· Deep personalization (Pro)
· Markdown or Plain Text
· Syncs with iCloud
· Integrates with TextExpander
· Publishes drafts to Medium, WordPress, Ghost, or Micro.blog
· Exports to PDF, HTML, RTF, DOCX, ePub, image, or clipboard
· Works seamlessly across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac
# PRO FEATURES
Basic adjustments like text size are free in Paper. More advanced personalization can be purchased with Pro Features. You will not be buying anything blindly, though. The trial period for Pro Features is untimed, so you can take your time to decide if they are a worthy investment.
While trialing Pro Features, you might occasionally see a popup. Simply press Reset in the popup to get rid of it completely.
Pro Features are either a subscription or a one-time purchase. Both the subscription and the one-time purchase unlock Pro Features on all your iPhones and iPads that share the same Apple ID. This subscription (or one-time purchase) applies only to iPhones and iPads. Macs require a separate subscription (or one-time purchase).
The one-time purchase is hidden by default. To enable it, go to the Settings app → Apps → Paper → Purchases → toggle "Show Lifetime Option".
If you want to upgrade from a Monthly subscription to a Yearly one (or to a Lifetime license), go to Paper’s page in the App Store and press the rounded button with the price next to the Yearly subscription option (or next to the Lifetime in-app purchase).
# BUSINESSES, SCHOOLS & ORGANIZATIONS
Businesses, schools, and organizations can use one of the following methods to purchase the Pro version of the app:
· Apple Business Manager
· Apple School Manager
· Volume Purchasing
The Pro version of the app can be accessed from this link → paper.pro/get

## How do I share my document?
· On the main screen with documents: Tap and hold the document. Select "Share" from the menu.
· In the document editor: Tap the title of the document in the top bar, then tap the round "Share" button in the popup.
## How do I print my document?
· On the main screen with documents: Tap and hold the document. Select "Print" from the menu.
· In the document editor: Tap the title of the document in the top bar. Select "Print" from the menu.
## Can I draw in the app?
No. Paper is purely a plain-text editor.
## Can I add pictures?
You can only link to public images on the Web.
## Can I password-protect my notes?
No.

· Change the keyboard to a non-alphabetic one (Japanese, Chinese, Korean, etc.).
· Tap the "Settings" button in the top right corner.
· Under the "Font" submenu, toggle "Keep for ABC Keyboards".

You can reach me via the in-app chat → "Settings" button in the corner → "Chat with the Maker"

COMBINE RABBITS TO CREATE MUTANTS AND TAKE OVER THE WORLD
I’ve got ears for days and big teeth, and I can bring you eggs but I’m not a bird. What am I? An ugly waiter? No, dummy, a rabbit! It might not be Easter, but it’s definitely bunny season for the addictive Evolution series, so get ready to drag, drop and dare, because your new favorite pet will be a hare!
Mix and match to your heart’s content and fill the world with tons of cute, fluffy and sometimes slightly scary rabbit mutations. It’s so adorable you’ll want to hug your screen!
FLUFFY FEATURES
• Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the rabbits
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar rabbits to create new mysterious creatures
• Use rabbit eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a rabbit to make coins pop from their eggs
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many rabbit species to discover
• A mind-blowing story with hare-fying twists
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No rabbits were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
It’s bunny time, hunny!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

bluejetty:00024882:ios.description:
Are you ready to experience the most addictive hidden objects game right now? 
Find all hidden objects by moving around the interactive maps and completing quests to unlock new colorful locations. Found It! is a fun and engaging hidden picture game that exercises your brain and promotes problem-solving skills. 
Found It is a new search and find bright hidden object game where you should solve the objects puzzles and unlock new maps for free. All you need to do is to focus on the requested item, do a scavenger hunt, step inside various locations with engaging scenes, and complete the tasks. Use hints to put your target and find it. You can also zoom in, out, and swipe through every corner of the map. 
Search, seek and find out fantastic graphics. Hundreds of hidden objects await you to collect and unlock new levels. If you are fond of playing detective, scavenger hunt games, finding hidden objects, and puzzle games, then this brain teaser is your best choice. Playing Found It you will train your brain and improve your searching skills and attention. 
Features: 
- Enjoy the pleasure of playing the hidden object games for free!
- Relax with the best Found It game anywhere & anytime!
- Simple gameplay and rules. Observe the scene, find the hidden objects, and finish the scene!
- Suitable for groups of all ages. Play the picture puzzle game with your friends and family members. 
- Various difficulties. The more hidden objects you find out, the more intricate maps you can challenge.
- Powerful tools. Use helpful hints to find the hidden object when you get stuck.
- Zoom feature. Zoom in and out at any moment to see the well hidden objects!
- Multiple scenes and levels. Playground, animal park, ocean world, and more destinations are waiting for you!
Improve your concentration, attention, and observation skills with Found It!

bluejetty:00044451:ios.summary:
Are you trying to improve your health by eating better? Nourish connects you with a Registered Dietitian through telehealth, and gets it covered by your insurance!
Nourish provides personalized, empathetic care and a focus on sustainable h
bluejetty:00044451:ios.description:
Are you trying to improve your health by eating better? Nourish connects you with a Registered Dietitian through telehealth, and gets it covered by your insurance!
Nourish provides personalized, empathetic care and a focus on sustainable healthy habits. A Registered Dietitian will help you build a plan to achieve your health goals. By pairing this evidence-based nutrition therapy with technology that supports you on your health journey, Nourish makes it easier for you to eat better.
With the Nourish app, you can:
• Schedule and manage appointments with your registered dietitian
• Chat with your dietitian
• Track your macros easily with AI-powered meal logging
• Explore healthy recipes
• Order healthy, medically-tailored meals for delivery
• Measure your health progress, including an Apple Health integration
• Track your nutrition goals and health progress
• View summaries written by your registered dietitian and the status of your insurance claims for past appointments
In the coming months, the Nourish app will launch additional features that help our patients eat better, including meal planning, goal setting, and more! 
Patients that use Nourish report an average satisfaction of 9.5 out of 10, and love that Nourish is:
• Affordable: 94% of Nourish patients pay $0 out of pocket
• Convenient: 100% virtual - use telehealth to meet with your registered dietitian wherever you are, whenever it's best for you
• Effective: 91% of people who used Nourish reported they felt happier and healthier after twelve weeks of working with their registered dietitian
Who can Nourish help? In short, anyone that needs help eating better! We have registered dietitians who are experts and serve patients looking for help with:
• Weight loss
• Eating disorders
• Diabetes and prediabetes
• General health
• Emotional eating
• Gut health
• Heart health
• Women's health, and pre and postnatal nutrition
• Pediatrics
• Sports nutrition
• Vegan/vegetarian eating
• and more!
Download the Nourish app or visit our website https://www.nourish.com to get started today!

bluejetty:00099954:ios.summary:

From happy giggles to hungry cries, every moment in this babysitting game is part of a warm journey your children will love. This kids game lets yo
bluejetty:00099954:ios.description:
Welcome to your new virtual baby care game — the cutest mom life simulator family adventure!
From happy giggles to hungry cries, every moment in this babysitting game is part of a warm journey your children will love. This kids game lets your child learn to nurture, feed, and play with virtual little ones anytime and anywhere. It turns everyday care into fun games for girls and joyful learning for the whole family - a perfect start for early development and preschool fun.
Key features
- Virtual family baby daycare for safe and caring play
- Fun mini-games for kids
- Adorable room decorations
- Cute dress-up items for baby style
- Camera to capture family moments
Keep your baby happy
The baby’s needs change over time. Care for them with love and attention to keep them happy and smiling. You and your family can enjoy this baby simulator together. It teaches empathy, patience, and the joy of caring for others. This baby learning game brings families closer through play and helps kids understand what it means to raise a baby in a loving home.
Customize the room
Decorate a cozy space with colours, furniture, and accessories to make it warm and welcoming. Use imagination to make every corner special and full of joy for your family in this infant game. 
Dress up your baby
This kids game for girls is perfect for those who love fashion and creativity. Choose between different clothes, shoes, and accessories to dress your virtual baby in cute and playful outfits your whole family will enjoy. 
Capture special moments
Use the in-game camera to capture sweet family memories in your baby’s world. Create joyful moments that parents and children can cherish together every day. 
Why kids and parents love it
This is more than a mother simulator baby sitting app — it’s a full babysitter game where children and parents share joyful learning. Kids practice caring, feeding, and creativity. The app is safe and cheerful, offering parents a fun way to bond with their children and experience everyday life moments together.
Discover the joy of nurturing, playing, and creating in this family-oriented baby game with smooth controls and bright design. It’s perfect for fans of fun games for girls and for family playtime.
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get exclusive bonuses:
1. 18 premium games
2. 225 unique content items
3. "Baby Room Customization" feature
4. "Photo Saving" feature
5. Regular updates
Make your life easier with premium access:
- Check its advantages, by getting a free three-day trial. After 3 days, the trial will automatically turn to the weekly paid subscription.
- The paid subscription is divided into the 3 types: weekly, monthly, and year.
- A week paid subscription costs $9.99. Month - $19.99. Year - $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy https://jmhdevelopers.com/privacy.html
And Terms of use https://jmhdevelopers.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00082465:ios.description:
【Ghoul World】
“Ghouls” lurk around Tokyo, hunting humans and devouring their flesh. Ken Kaneki, a bookworm who frequented the café “Anteiku”, met a woman there. Both were at a similar age, in a similar situation, and even fond of the same books; they began to grow closer. And yet… after a date in a bookstore, Ken Kaneki was involved in an accident that changed his fate, and was forced to transplant a "ghoul" organ...
Ken Kaneki regards this twisted world with doubt and uncertainty, yet all the while he's drawn into its clutches in an inescapably terrible spiral.
【Game Introduction】
◆Meet your favorite characters
Experience the dynamic battle scenes of the characters with 3D cel-shaded CG animation.
Create your powerful lineup with more than 30 characters!
◆Relive the classic scenes of “Tokyo Ghoul”
Return to the ghoul world in iconic cutscenes reimagined with 3D cel-shaded CG animation!
Experience this world that is never-fading, full of charm and uncertainty!
◆Battles full of strategies
The timing of releasing the Ultimate Skills and the lineups are the keys to your victory!
Strategic factors such as the order of skill releasing and the timing of the Ultimate Skills may also turn the tide!
◆Multiple game modes
Classic storylines between “humans and Ghouls”, Instances that can be challenged by a single player, co-op battles that allows you to fight along with other players, real-time PVP battles... There are so much more for you to experience!
【Automatic Subscription Service Description】
Subscription Service:
a) Monthly Pack (One Month)
Subscription Price:
a) Monthly Pack: The auto-renewing monthly product is priced at 4.99 USD/month.
Payment: After the user confirms the purchase and completes the payment, the amount will be charged to the iTunes account.
Auto-Renewal: The Apple iTunes account will be charged 24 hours before the current subscription expires. Once payment is successful, the subscription period will be extended by one cycle.
Service Cancellation: You can manage your auto-subscription service by going to "Settings" on your iPhone --> Enter "iTunes Store & App Store" --> Click "Apple ID," select "View Apple ID," and go to the "Account Settings" page. Tap "Subscriptions" to manage your subscription. To cancel, turn off the auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle. If canceled within 24 hours before expiration, no further charges will be made.
Privacy Policy: http://www.funcatgames.com/privacy-yy
terms：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00069802:ios.description:
TACO Food Table
The Brazilian Table of Food Composition (TACO) is the result of a project coordinated by NEPA of UNICAMP with the support and financing of the Ministries of Health and Social Development.
In this table you will find more than 500 foods with their detailed nutritional compositions.
This application allows the table data, authored by the authors above, to be searched and organized automatically.
STANDARD VERSION:
- List with all foods
- Allows you to change the volume / quantity in grams of each food by automatically calculating the nutritional properties and compositions
PRO VERSION:
- Save food as favorites, making it easier to search and use on a daily basis
- Generate an image with the nutritional properties of each food so that it can be shared
- Create lists to organize your diets: for example, create lists of breakfast, post workout, afternoon snack, etc!
Information about subscriptions and in-app purchases:
Subscriptions are available. You can sign up and pay through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Automatic renewal can be disabled after purchase, just go to the "Manage subscription" page in the settings. The features will be available until the end of the current monthly fee. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will be renewed at the same cost. Please note: unused parts of the free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to the publication, when applicable. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase and at the beginning of each renewal period.
* prices vary by region

bluejetty:00023517:ios.name: Quran Majeed Pro القرآن المجيد
bluejetty:00023517:ios.summary:
Most authentic Quran app since 2010.
Recognized by more than 100 million Muslim users around the world.
تطبيق القرآن الأكثر اعتمادا منذ عام ٢٠١٠.
معترف به من قبل أكثر من ١٠٠ مليون مستخدم حول العالم.
Quran Majeed is an amazing Quran app
bluejetty:00023517:ios.description:
Most authentic Quran app since 2010.
Recognized by more than 100 million Muslim users around the world.
تطبيق القرآن الأكثر اعتمادا منذ عام ٢٠١٠.
معترف به من قبل أكثر من ١٠٠ مليون مستخدم حول العالم.
Quran Majeed is an amazing Quran app that beautifies your life with the blessing of reading and listening to the Quran on the go. The latest version of the authentic Quran Majeed app for iPhone and iPad offers complete Quran in the elegant Uthmanic script, audio recitation, translations and English Tafsir Uthmani, proofread by a Muslim scholar ('alim).
القرآن المجيد هو تطبيق مميز للقرآن الذي يجمل حياتك ببركة القراءة والاستماع إلى القرآن أثناء التنقل. الإصدار الأخير من تطبيق القرآن المجيد لأجهزة الآي فون والآيباد تقدم قرآنًا كاملاً في الكتابة العثمانية الأنيقة، وتلاوة الصوت، والترجمات، والتفاسير، وقام بمراجعته أحد العلماء
● Worldwide Prayer Times clock with Azan/Adhan alarm options. Supports different prayer time calculation methods. Qibla direction. Ramadan Sehar/Iftar times
أوقات الصلاة لجميع أنحاء العالم مع خيار تنبيه الأذان، ودعم طرق مختلفة لحساب أوقات الصلاة، وبوصلة القبلة، وأوقات السحور والإفطار
● World famous reciters (Sheikh Abdul Basit, Sheikh As Sudays & As Shraym, Mishari Rashid, Saad Al Ghamdi, Abu Bakr Shatry, Sheikh Ahmed Ajmi, Sheikh Al-Huzaifi, Sheikh Mahir-al-Muayqali, Sheikh Minshawi, Sheikh Ayub, Khalil Husari, Mahmood AlBana, Salah Bukhatir & Sheikh Basfar).
تلاوات القراء المعروفون عالميا.
● Four English translations (Pickthal, Dr. Mohsin, Mahmood & Yusuf Ali) and forty-five language translations (AlBanian, Amazigh, Amharic, Azerbaijani, Bengali, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Chinese, Divehi, Dutch, French, German, Hausa, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malayalam, Malaysian, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Sindhi, Somali, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tajik, Tamil, Tartar, Turkish, Urdu, Uyghur, Uzbek). 
● Option to display any translation along with full Arabic text in hi-resolution, Retina graphics in both portrait and landscape viewing. Supports pinch/zoom feature for changing font size.
خيار عرض أي ترجمة مع النص العربي الكامل بالدقة الممتازة في وضعي الأفقي والعمودي، دعم ميزة التصغير / التكبير لتغيير حجم الخط.
● Islamic greeting messages (Eid Mubarak, Ramadan Kareem, ...)
رسائل معايدة إسلامية (عيد مبارك، رمضان كريم، ...)
● Qibla Direction — اتجاه القبلة
● Hijri Converter — تحويل التاريخ
● Quran TV feature with beautiful background videos
تلفزيون القرآن مع مقاطع فيديو خلفية جميلة
● Visual Quran feature with flip gesture
المصحف المرئي مع إيماءة التقليب
● Watch live coverage of Makkah & Madinah.
شاهد التغطية المباشرة لمكة المكرمة والمدينة المنورة.
● Selectable themes (Green, Blue, Classic-Green, Night Mode, Light & Brown).
إمكانية اختيار الثيمات (أخضر، أزرق، الوضع الليلي، فاتح، بني)
● Advanced audio options to help with memorization (repetition of ayah, Surah, number of repetitions, interval, and recitation speed).
خيارات الصوت المتقدمة للمساعدة في الحفظ (تكرار الآية، وسورة، وعدد من حالات التكرار، وفاصل، وسرعة التلاوة).
● Highly advanced “Search” feature that can help with searching any word (search exact word, affixes or all roots) in the Arabic text, any of the translations and English Tafsir.
ميزة بحث متقدم يساعد في البحث عن أي كلمة ( الكلمة بالضبط، كل اللاحقات أو الجذور) في النص العربي، والترجمات والتفاسير
● Bookmarking of Aya, translation and tafsir (supports iCloud synchronization that helps your bookmarks stay up to date on all your iOS devices).
وضع علامة مرجعية على الأية، والترجمة، والتفسير للرجوع إليها
● Quranic Aya and word highlighting during recitation.
تظليل الآية والكلمة أثناء التلاوة
● Social media sharing. Ability to share selected aya via email, twitter & Facebook.
مشاركة في وسائل الإعلام الاجتماعية
● iPad friendly interface
تطابق واجهة أيباد
Terms & Conditions
https://pakdata.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy
https://pakdata.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00018240:ios.description:
People's Mobile Banking from People’s Community Federal Credit Union allows you to manage your money anywhere life takes you. Whether you're paying bills, depositing a check, transferring funds, or just checking your balance; mobile banking is at your fingertips! Not yet a PCCU Online Banking User (required to use People’s Mobile Banking)? Go to www.peoplescu.org and sign-up today. Free to all People’s Community Federal Credit Union members (your mobile carrier's message and data rates may apply for People’s Mobile Banking).
Through People’s Mobile Banking, you can:
• View all your account balances
• Deposit checks quickly using your iPhone’s camera 
• Help avoid fees and get notified of suspicious activity with text or email alerts
• View your credit card transactions and manage your rewards program
• Make transfers between your accounts at People’s as well as at other Financial Institutions
• Pay your bills quickly and easily with Free Bill Pay
• With Popmoney, send money to just about anyone in the U.S. without sharing account numbers. All you need is their mobile number or email address.
Security:
Mobile data transmissions are safeguarded by 256-bit SSL (Secure Socket Layer) to prevent unauthorized access
We never transmit your account number (your accounts are referred to only by nicknames), and account information is not stored on your phone

bluejetty:00077154:ios.description:
This isn't just another fishing app—it's a fishing intelligence engine. LakeMonster's AI analyzes millions of data points to deliver predictive forecasts and tactical maps, giving you an unprecedented edge on the water.
Meet your new fishing partner. And it's an AI.
LakeMonster is the first fishing intelligence platform designed to think like an expert angler. Our powerful AI processes satellite imagery, weather patterns, bathymetric data, and thousands of historical fishing logs to translate complex data into one simple goal: helping you catch more fish.
Stop guessing. Start knowing.
THE AI-POWERED ADVANTAGE:
Predictive Fish Forecasts: Our AI doesn't just report the weather; it predicts fish behavior. Get dynamic forecasts showing peak bite windows and AI-generated hotspot maps for any lake.
Intelligent Safety Maps: Fish with greater confidence. The AI generates predictive Ice Safety Maps by modeling thickness based on weather history and lake dynamics. Our Water Clarity Maps use satellite data to help you find clear water and avoid murky areas.
Tactical Depth & Thermal Maps: Discover underwater structures where fish hide. The AI enhances high-accuracy Bathymetric Depth Maps and pinpoints thermoclines with Thermal Maps to show you exactly where to cast.
BUILT FOR THE SERIOUS ANGLER:
LakeMonster is the essential toolkit for:
Ice Fishing: Find safer ice and target active winter fish.
Kayak & Boat Fishing: Navigate with precision and discover new honey holes.
Tournament Anglers: Get the data-driven, competitive edge when every fish counts.
LakeMonster Pro – Unlock the Full AI Engine
Upgrade to unleash the platform's full potential:
Unlimited AI-Powered Fishing Forecasts & Hotspots
Advanced Predictive Ice Safety Mapping
Full access to Water Clarity, Thermal & 3D Depth Maps
AI-Generated Strategies for your Target Species
Free Version Available
Get started with basic lake conditions, standard weather, and free depth map previews.
Download LakeMonster. Upgrade your tackle box with an AI.

bluejetty:00095700:ios.name: Dead Impact: Survival RPG Game
bluejetty:00095700:ios.summary:
Survive the apocalypse together in Dead Impact – the ultimate co-op zombie survival RPG!
Dive into the intense post-apocalyptic world of Dead Impact, a thrilling MMORPG adventure where survival depends on teamwork. Join forces with friends
bluejetty:00095700:ios.description:
Survive the apocalypse together in Dead Impact – the ultimate co-op zombie survival RPG!
Dive into the intense post-apocalyptic world of Dead Impact, a thrilling MMORPG adventure where survival depends on teamwork. Join forces with friends to raid dangerous locations, battle zombies and deadly bosses, and scavenge for essential supplies. Build your shelter, craft weapons, and upgrade your hero to become an unstoppable survivor.
- Co-op survival action: team up with friends or brave the challenges solo
- Unique classes, each with distinct abilities, so you can create your perfect fighting style and customize your appearance
- Weapons with special powers that can turn the tide of battle
- Survival game with increased durability of items, extensive crafting & construction system
- HARD MODE: for veteran survivors who crave even tougher battles and bigger rewards
- Battle Pass: complete quests and earn exclusive rewards
A world after the asteroid impact
After the asteroid’s destruction of civilization, humanity is scattered across desolate landscapes, clinging to life in small bands of survivors. As the undead roam and danger lurks around every corner, you and your team must find shelter, gather resources, and fight for survival in this transformed world.
Unite and conquer the undead together
Switch between classes like Rogue, Engineer, Alchemist, Trap Master, and Pyromancer—each with unique skills and playstyle.
Immersive multiplayer RPG
Form alliances with friends or other players during intense raids, use chat to coordinate your tactics, and face the challenges of the undead together. 
Customize your hero
In this immersive MMORPG, your hero’s destiny is yours to shape. Unlock new skills, fine-tune your equipment, and become the ultimate survivor.
Craft, loot, and build to thrive
Survive by gathering resources, crafting powerful gear, and constructing shelters to withstand the relentless undead. Conquer the apocalypse in this action-packed multiplayer RPG!
Explore a dangerous world
Journey through a vast open world, from desert sands to frozen forests and the ruins of abandoned cities. Brave the underground catacombs where the dead guard treasures beyond imagination.
Experience the ultimate zombie survival adventure in this cooperative online RPG. Build your team, customize your hero, and forge your path in a world reborn from destruction. Are you ready to face the challenge?

bluejetty:00026153:ios.name: SnapType
bluejetty:00026153:ios.summary:
SnapType helps students keep up with their peers in class even when their penmanship holds them back. Students can easily complete school worksheets with the help of an iPad or iPhone.
With SnapType, students can take a picture of their wo
bluejetty:00026153:ios.description:
SnapType helps students keep up with their peers in class even when their penmanship holds them back. Students can easily complete school worksheets with the help of an iPad or iPhone.
With SnapType, students can take a picture of their worksheets, or import worksheets from anywhere on their device. They can then use their iOS device keyboard to add text to these documents and print, email, or share their creations. It is the perfect solution for kids, and even adults, who struggle with their handwriting. Just read a few of our amazing testimonials:
"Dear Amberlynn, Thank you so much for creating this app. You have changed the way my 12 year old son with dyspraxia functions in school. He is more independent and I cannot thank you enough. Please continue to help kids like my son. You are changing lives. Thank you."
"Thank you for this ! I am going to talk to my sons teachers about this -you are a blessing ! I can honestly tell you that I have spent many hours crying inside an Hurting watching my son struggle to write pages of sentences and spelling words and other homework - to the point that I have stopped him and honestly wrote for him left handed to make it look more like a neater version of his because I could not take it anymore ! Thank you"
"I just wanted to personally thank you for creating it, as this is an app that I use nearly every day with my son to do his homework. You have created an app with a simple interface, but with an incredibly powerful impact. Thank you."
"It is wonderful and something so simple yet so so so important for little guys like mine who cannot write BUT is learning to type and has so much to say and SHOW."
"We trialed SnapType with an 8-year old who is receiving school-based occupational therapy due to visual motor and visual perceptual issues. The biggest complaint from teachers about handwriting for this student was related to illegible answers on worksheets. The student quickly learned to take images of the worksheets with her iPad, upload them to the device and type in her answers. In addition to making her writing legible and eliminating issues with visual perceptual skills, the child's interest in the task was greatly improved, as was her pride in her work."
"Thank you so much Amberlynn. What a wonderful idea and gift to those kids that struggle with dysgraphia. I have converted many a workbook page for my son. This is WONDERFUL!"
"Thank you, thank you, thank you. I'm a mother of twins. My son is autistic and my daughter has cerebral palsy. They are still only 2 and a half... but I'm sure they will both need and use this. The fact that you have also made it free and are paying for it out of pocket is just the sweetest thing ever. I read about this last night and cried tears of joy. You are amazing! And I'm going to be telling everyone who will listen about you, this story, and your app. Thank you again, I truly appreciate it!!”

bluejetty:00061460:ios.description:
INAAM is a loyalty Program specially designed to aid the Purchasing habits of our loyal customers extending our service to a family audience by giving them an opportunity to shop more at much less through this innovative program.
INAAM would earn substantial savings to the vast number of customers who consider NESTO as their second home.
Currently operating in the countries of INDIA, UAE, KSA, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, and Kuwait, the NESTO footprint is soon expected to expand into other markets in Asia.
NESTO is all about getting you All the Quality you need, All the Freshness you need, All the Style you need, All the Fashion you need, All the Range you need, and in short, All that you need to maintain a cost-effective, yet a quality-driven lifestyle.
INAAM adds value to this relationship by fetching your Reward Points for every purchase enabling you to redeem these points for more purchases.
1. How to collect points?
It is simple, just produce your card at the time of your purchase, the cashier will scan your card and complete the billing. The points will be credited to your card immediately. Please note that the points cannot be collected for Cigarettes and Telephone cards.
2. How many points do you collect for your purchase?
You will get 1 point for every AED 5 purchase.
3. How and when to get your vouchers? (Redemption of points)
- You can redeem your points to get the voucher on the basis of the above qualification criteria.
- Redemption of points for a voucher is possible at any time from the INAAM kiosk or the customer service Desk (CSD).
- Once you redeem your points for vouchers, equivalent points will be deducted from your total points available as of that date.

DISCOVER NEW SHOWS & MOVIES:
RECOMMENDATIONS: Take advantage of expert curation and algorithms to find the best shows and movies.

• SEARCH: Search the catalog of hundreds of thousands of titles.
SEE WHAT’S AIRING
• LOCAL LISTINGS: Get a personalized channel schedule by selecting any cable, satellite, or antenna provider in North America.
• NEW TONIGHT: See the top new primetime shows airing on both broadcast and cable, including CBS, NBC, ABC, Fox, Ion, HGTV, Hallmark, USA Network, History, TLC, TBS, Discovery, TNT, The CW, and A&E.
• FAVORITE CHANNELS: View the listings schedule for the channels you love by saving your favorites.
• TIME JUMP: Jump to the primetime lineup for tonight, tomorrow, or any date within the next 2 weeks.
STAY UP TO DATE ON YOUR FAVORITES
• COMING SOON: See upcoming episodes, seasons, or premieres of shows and movies from your Watchlist.
• AVAILABLE NOW: Browse the VOD titles on your Watchlist, and tap Quick Watch to start watching on the best available service.
• AIRING REMINDERS: Get notified 30 minutes before a show or movie on your Watchlist begins airing.
• WATCHLIST EMAIL DIGEST: Check out last week's news and streaming additions, and get ready for next week’s lineup.
Download TV Guide today to keep up with all the best TV shows and movies!
TV Guide is a digital media brand that explores TV shows and streaming entertainment, serves fans, and helps people decide what to watch next — on any platform. You can count on TV Guide’s editors to guide your TV and streaming viewing experience with honest reviews, curated recommendations, breaking news, in-depth interviews, smart recaps, and more immersive content that digs deep into your TV obsessions.

bluejetty:00037818:ios.description:
Vivaldi Browser is a powerful, personal, and private web browser. It comes packed with built-in features including desktop-style tabs, an Ad Blocker, tracking protection. Designed to put you back in control. Trusted by millions of users across the world.
FEATURES:
- Ad Blocker: Browse with minimal distractions.
- Tracker Blocker: Stay protected with leading privacy and security features.
- Custom Wallpapers & Themes: Pick a theme and background that matches your style.
- Dark Mode for all webpages: Force Dark Mode to every website you visit.
- Desktop-like tabs: Efficiently manage multiple websites at once.
- Encrypted Sync: Seamlessly sync data across your mobile and desktop devices.
- Notes: Jot down thoughts and ideas while browsing.
- Bookmarks: Organize your favorite sites effortlessly.
- Reading Lists: Save articles for offline reading.
- Custom App Icon: Personalize Vivaldi's appearance on your home screen.
- Switch Search Engines: Choose your preferred search engine on the fly.
POWERFUL
Packed with flexible features, all built in.
PERSONAL
You make it your own, Vivaldi adapts to you.
PRIVATE
We don't track you, or your behavior.
DESKTOP-LIKE TABS
Bring the robust tab management from your desktop to your iOS device. Vivaldi on iOS features a unique Tab Bar akin to the desktop browser. To activate or deactivate the Tab Bar, head to Vivaldi menu > Settings, and tap on "Show Tab Bar" to toggle the setting.
SYNC ACROSS DEVICES
Never feel out of touch. Sync your data across devices with end-to-end encryption. From open tabs and saved logins to bookmarks and notes, everything is seamlessly available wherever you go. Add an extra layer of security with an encryption password.
SET AS DEFAULT BROWSER
Ready to make the switch? Set Vivaldi as your default browser and experience the web like never before. Here's how: Go to Settings, scroll down to Vivaldi, and select it as your Default Browser App. It's that simple!
ABOUT VIVALDI
With millions active users and a vibrant community of over 1.4 million members worldwide, Vivaldi is redefining what a web browser can be. At Vivaldi, we believe a browser should be powerful, personal, and private. With our unique philosophy of "respect, question, create, and deliver," we're crafting a browsing experience that adapts to you, not the other way around.
Some of the links in this app are affiliate links. If you make a purchase through these links, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you. This helps support the development of Vivaldi and keeps the web browser independent. Thank you for your support!
By downloading Vivaldi, you are agreeing to the End User License Agreement at https://vivaldi.com/privacy/vivaldi-end-user-license-agreement/. Learn more about how Vivaldi handles and protects your data in our Privacy Policy at https://vivaldi.com/privacy/browser/.

bluejetty:00078619:ios.description:
Here's everything you get when you subscribe today (we think it's a steal): 
* PHLOWSYNC™: A world first! Never before have you been able to go from capture to professionally colored photo straight to Photos App in full RAW non-destructively. No more exporting or duplicate files. Just shoot photos with Phlow and edit them as you normally would. All changes sync back to that file in Photos App. 
* PRO (RAW) CAMERA:
No Fusion. No Jpgs (unless you want them)… The heart of Phlow is our raw camera. Shoot stunning images in PhlowRAW (our proprietary raw imaging process) with your favorite presets and film emulations in real time. Whether you're looking for a vintage effect, polaroid style vibe, or subtle film effect, we have you covered. 
* INTERVAL CAMERA (SELF TIMER):
Solo content creators rejoice! Our beautiful interval camera allows you to take up to 30 photos in your desired interval timing (a photo every 2, 3, 5, 10 seconds etc). 
* UNRIVALED PRO PHOTO & VIDEO FILTERS AND PRESETS (SETS):
Quality over everything. We've perfected the art of color grading to make your life easier. Simple, stunning, and mistakable for film. Natural pro-level color grading including film filters, photo grain, and film effects.
* LIVE PRESET VIDEO COLOR GRADING:
Shoot live videos with your favorite video filter effects and color in real time! A huge time saver for those who want to just shoot and post. Great for longer form content, selfie videos, YouTube makeup tutorial style videos and anything else you don't want to manually edit. 
* SEAMLESS CAMERA ROLL INTEGRATION:
Editing photos and editing videos from anywhere on your device through our seamless camera roll integration. 
* 4K VIDEO EDITING (COLOR GRADING):
Beautiful color grading over your 4K footage, with the ability to scrub and trim your video while you edit. 
* BLUR TOOL, BLOOM TOOL, GRAIN TOOL (MORE COMING SOON!):
The perfect effects for that dream glow and film aesthetic.
* STACK+ "TAP TO ADD" EFFECTS:
STACK+ quick add-ons are a simple way to quickly layer effects on top of your edit. Add authentic Film Curves and effects for real film effects, one click color toning color enhancers, fades and more. 
* HDR VIDEO COLOR GRADING:
HDR is here to stay but that doesn't mean those videos can't be colored to your liking. Your HDR content can now look just as good as your standard video color grades. 
* PRO TOOLS:
Tools that just work well. Pro level exposure tool, HSL for targeting specific colors, copy/paste, and many more to come in future updates.
* PROFESSIONAL LEVEL EXPORT QUALITY:
Forget fuzzy uploads. High quality exports are here and they separate your content from the crowd. Stunning exports that will stand out on instagram, TikTok, and all other social platforms. 
* PHLOW CAMERA WIDGET:
Quick draw access to the Phlow camera! One tap of our widget opens the camera so that you never miss the moment
Join the Phlow family today! We're excited to see you on the inside. 
What others are saying:
"This app is one of the most incredible things I've come across! The raw camera has absolutely blown me away!!! It shoots so dang good and my husband also hasn't stopped raving about it. I just got home from a Europe trip and I was able to get some amazing pictures throughout the beautiful places we visited with Phlow!"
Auto renewable subscription information: 
Start your Phlow subscription with a 7 day free trial on our annual plan. Once your trial ends, you will be charged for the annual subscription. Your Phlow subscription will automatically renew, unless auto renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off your subscription anytime from your phone settings. The seven day trial only applies to the annual subscription.

Read our privacy policy: https://phlowapp.com/pages/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00029633:ios.name: GymGoal Pro
bluejetty:00029633:ios.summary:
Praised by pros and trainers as the most capable and flexible workout planner and tracker.
• The only app that can handle any routine and workout.
• Organizes your workouts and helps you reach your goals in strength, muscle size or weight
bluejetty:00029633:ios.description:
Praised by pros and trainers as the most capable and flexible workout planner and tracker.
• The only app that can handle any routine and workout.
• Organizes your workouts and helps you reach your goals in strength, muscle size or weight loss. It will empower you with knowledge and revolutionize your workouts.
• Featured in The New York Times, Consumer Reports, The Daily. 
FEATURES 
(Everything is included immediately. No additional purchases)
• 390 exercises with animations and step by step instructions. You can add your own exercises.
• Text, pictures, animated GIFs and youtube clips can be attached to any exercise.
• 67 workout routines. You can add your own routines.
• Flexible tracking system for strength, cardio, plyometrics, stretching workouts, circuit training, Tabata or any other workout type. Supports supersets, freeform notes and much more. Workout history is fully editable.
• The workout logging screen is optimized for fast data entry, but remains feature-rich. You can copy data from the history, add new exercises, images and videos without interrupting your workout.
• Bodyweight and assisted-weight exercises automatically account for your body weight.
• Timers for exercise duration, rests, circuits.
• GymGoal calculates your One Rep Max for every exercise.
• Workout history by muscle shows muscles that you neglect.
• Weekly and rotating schedules support up to 4 workout sessions a day.
• Heart rate monitoring with Apple Watch or a Bluetooth 4 device. While working out: graph, max/average, warning when heart rate leaves the target zone. In the workout history: heart rate graphs, stats.
• GPS tracking. Interactive map during the workout. Trail, distance and speed recording. Maps saved to the workout history. Distance, time, speed shown for any trail part.
• Body measurements tracking plus additional custom trackers.
• The best in class Body Fat tracking module includes calculators, several skinfolds (calipers) methods, direct entry.
• One-rep Max, BMI, BMR, TDEE, Target Heart Rate calculators and progress tracking.
• Apple Watch support - workout logging, heart rate, timers.
• Integration with the Health app: two-way syncing of BMI, BMR, Body Fat, weight and height, export of workout data, including burned calories.
• Two-way syncing with RunKeeper and MapMyFitness - both cardio and strength workouts.
• You don't need an Internet connection - everything is stored on your device.
• Ability to back up your data to the server (free), or to email it. You can copy your data between iPhones and other supported devices.
• Workout logs, measurements, routines and the schedule can be emailed for review and printing. Workout logs can be opened in Excel.
• Up to 50 user accounts.
YOU CAN DEPEND ON GYMGOAL 
• GymGoal is in AppStore since 2008. It is used by over a million people, from beginners to pro athletes and trainers, and even in schools. 
• Many people have 9 years of detailed workout history in GymGoal. Years of history do not slow GymGoal down.
• Updates will not lose your routines, schedule or workout history. Even if your iPhone breaks, you will be able to restore your data from the server backup.

bluejetty:00087661:ios.summary:

Canada Citizenship Prep Guide gives you everything you need in one calm, easy-to-use app: realistic practice tests, th
bluejetty:00087661:ios.description:
Get ready for your Canadian citizenship test with practice questions based on Discover Canada, the official study guide.
Canada Citizenship Prep Guide gives you everything you need in one calm, easy-to-use app: realistic practice tests, the full study guide as an audio book, key dates in Canadian history, and facts about every province and territory.
UP TO DATE FOR 2026
The question bank has been reviewed and refreshed with 470 extra questions, including recent changes you may be asked about:
• King Charles III as Canada's Head of State
• The updated Oath of Citizenship, which recognizes the rights of Indigenous Peoples
• Truth and Reconciliation, and the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation
• Canada's current Governor General and Prime Minister
• The gender-neutral wording of O Canada
A dedicated "Recent updates" test covers all of these.
PRACTICE THE WAY YOU LIKE
• Practice Mode: take your time and see the right answer after every question
• Timed Mode: 20 seconds per question to build test-day confidence
• Random tests: 20 questions drawn from the whole bank, with your best and last scores saved
• 16 Full Tests: work through every question in the bank, one test at a time, and track which ones you've passed
FEEDBACK THAT ENCOURAGES YOU
Wrong answers aren't punished. You'll see the right answer clearly with a gentle "Good try!" so you learn from every question and keep going.
LISTEN TO DISCOVER CANADA
Download the audio book once and listen any time, even offline. Playback continues in the background and from your lock screen, so you can study while you commute, cook or walk.
LEARN THE ESSENTIALS
• History: key years and dates in Canada's story, with search
• Provinces & Territories: capitals and key facts for all 13
• Did You Know?: a new fact about Canada every time you open the app
DESIGNED FOR FOCUS
A clean, dark design that's easy on the eyes, on both iPhone and iPad. Your progress stays on your device.
ABOUT THE TEST
The citizenship test has 20 questions, and you need 15 correct answers to pass. It covers the rights and responsibilities of citizens, Canada's history, geography, economy, government, laws and symbols. Applicants aged 18 to 54 usually take the test.
This app is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Canada or Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC). Always check IRCC's website for the latest official information.
Good luck — and welcome to Canada!

bluejetty:00043442:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00043442:ios.description:
Swally – Your life organized, in a single app
No more chaos, no more forgotten tasks, no more overflowing wallets! Swally is the all-in-one app that organizes documents, finances, home, cards, notes and reminders in a smart, simple and fast way. Designed for those who want everything under control, stress-free.
NEW: Finances and Home
Personal and family finances
Keep track of your money without connecting your bank. Record income, expenses and transfers, organize everything by accounts and categories and instantly see where your money goes.
- Accounts, income, expenses and transfers
- Monthly budgets and savings goals
- Automatic recurring transactions
- Charts, analysis and period comparison
- CSV export and data export
- Shared family spaces: manage household expenses together
Home, purchases and warranties
Turn Swally into the archive of your belongings: no more lost receipts or warranties expiring without noticing.
- Product inventory by room and category
- Receipt scanning with OCR: store, date and total filled in automatically
- Warranties with alerts before they expire
- Recurring maintenance with reminders
- Photos, receipts and manuals attached to each product
- Reports on the value of your belongings and PDF export for insurance
- Shared family inventory
Everything you love about Swally
Smart reminders
Set a memo and get a notification at the right time. Never miss a deadline again!
Deadlines Hub
Documents, warranties and maintenance in a single view, with automatic alerts before expiry.
Colorful and organized notes
Write, customize, group. Your ideas have never been so tidy and nice to look at, with checklists and attachments.
Loyalty cards always with you
Goodbye bulky wallets! Save all your loyalty cards and show the barcode straight from your iPhone.
Personal document management
Securely store important documents (passport, ID card, tax code, driver's license and more). Each document has tags and quick search, with automatic OCR filling and expiry alerts.
QR codes always ready
Scan, save or create QR codes and barcodes in a second. Useful, fast, immediate.
Built-in calculator
Need a quick calculation? The calculator is already inside Swally.
Secure and private
Biometric unlock (Face ID / Touch ID), data available offline and optional cloud backup to find everything on every device.
Why choose Swally?
Because it makes life easier. From documents to reminders, from finances to household belongings, from cards to notes: everything in a single app, always at hand. Swally is designed for you who want to live better, with less stress and more organization. Once you try it, you won't be able to do without it!
Swally PRO
Unlock unlimited accounts and products, budgets and goals, unlimited OCR, maintenance, reports, PDF/CSV export, shared family spaces and no ads.
The Swally PRO subscription is available with automatic renewal. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings.
For information, feedback or new ideas, write to us at: theswallyapp@gmail.com
Download Swally and organize documents, expenses, warranties and deadlines in a single app. Start for free today!
Privacy Policy: https://swally.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00087650:ios.name: Smart TV Remote Universal
bluejetty:00087650:ios.summary:
Lost the remote again? Your phone is now the only remote you need.
Smart TV Remote Universal turns your iPhone or iPad into a fast, reliable remote for nearly any smart TV — no infrared, no extra hardware, and no digging through couch cush
bluejetty:00087650:ios.description:
Lost the remote again? Your phone is now the only remote you need.
Smart TV Remote Universal turns your iPhone or iPad into a fast, reliable remote for nearly any smart TV — no infrared, no extra hardware, and no digging through couch cushions. Pair once over Wi-Fi and take control in seconds.
ONE APP FOR EVERY TV IN YOUR HOME
Pair multiple TVs and switch between rooms instantly — no re-pairing, no setup every time. Living room to bedroom in one tap.
CONTROL EVERYTHING
Power, volume, channels, inputs, playback and a full D-pad — every button from your physical remote, right on your screen, with real haptic feedback on every press.
TYPE INSTEAD OF HUNTING LETTERS
Stop picking letters one at a time on the TV screen. Use your phone's keyboard — or the numeric pad — to search shows, sign in to apps and enter passwords in a fraction of the time.
SWIPE TO NAVIGATE
A smooth trackpad lets you glide through menus with your thumb — faster and more natural than pressing arrow keys.
SPEAK INSTEAD OF SCROLLING
Use voice input to search and navigate on supported TVs — completely hands-free.
LAUNCH YOUR APPS IN ONE TAP
The apps grid takes you straight to your favorite streaming apps without hunting around the home screen.
CONTROL FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN & LOCK SCREEN
This is where Smart TV Remote Universal goes beyond any ordinary remote app:
- Home Screen widgets: a quick D-pad + volume widget and an app-launcher grid, one tap from anywhere
- Live Activity with Dynamic Island support — compact controls while you do other things
- Siri & Shortcuts support through App Intents: automate your TV or ask Siri
WORKS WITH YOUR TV
Compatible with Samsung, LG, Sony, Vizio, Hisense, Philips, Roku and Roku devices, Fire TV and Fire TV Stick, Google TV, Android TV and many more. If your smart TV is on your Wi-Fi, chances are we support it.
MAKE IT YOURS
Per-brand accent colors (Roku purple, Samsung blue, LG red and more), plus light, dark and system appearance.
READY IN UNDER A MINUTE
Connect your iPhone or iPad to the same Wi-Fi network as your TV and follow the on-screen steps. That's it — no pairing codes, no cables.
GO PRO
Upgrade to Pro for the complete, ad-free experience with unlimited paired devices and all widgets unlocked. Choose a yearly plan with a 3-day free trial, a monthly plan, or a one-time lifetime purchase.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, after any free trial period. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://tvremoteapp.art.blog/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Samsung, LG, Sony, Vizio, Hisense, Philips, Roku, Amazon, Google or any other TV brand mentioned. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Securely bank and manage business anytime, anywhere, across any device!
The Synovus Gateway Mobile Banking app provides Synovus commercial customers secure and easy-to-use cash management tools with the ability to bank and manage business anytime, anywhere, across any device. • Mobile Deposit
• User and Policy Management
• Statements
• Robust Alerts
• Business Bill Pay²
• Zelle® for your business²
• External Account Aggregation²
• Financial Management Tools²

• Minimum system requirement: iOS 16 or higher.
• Access to your device’s contacts is required for Zelle®.
• Access to your device’s photos is required for Zelle® when selecting a QR code from your saved images.

bluejetty:00043408:ios.description:
LEARN, UNDERSTAND & MEMORIZE THE QURAN. WITH FLASHCARDS & QUIZZES TO RETAIN WHAT YOU MEMORIZED.
Reconnect with the Quran in a deeper, more meaningful way. Whether you’re just beginning your journey or looking to strengthen your memorization, Quran Buddy is designed to help you engage with the Quran in a meaningful and consistent way. 
It combines simple learning tools with thoughtful structure, making it easier to understand, memorize, and reflect on the words of Allah.
From daily recitation to long-term memorization, the app supports learners of all levels—helping you move forward with clarity, confidence, and purpose.
---- KEY FEATURES ---- 
■ Quran-Based Flashcards
Learn essential Quranic vocabulary through carefully designed flashcards. Each word is selected to help you better understand what you recite, making your reading more thoughtful and connected.
■ Structured Memorization Support
Stay consistent with your memorization through a system built to help you review, retain, and progress at your own pace. Whether you're memorizing short surahs or longer passages, the app keeps you on track.
■ Interactive Quizzes & Review Tools
Reinforce what you’ve learned with simple quizzes that test your memory and understanding. A great way to stay motivated and measure your progress over time.
■ Learn Quranic Arabic
Start recognizing common words and patterns in the Quran, helping you understand meanings without relying entirely on translation.
■ Improve Your Recitation
Strengthen your recitation through regular practice and repetition. Build confidence as you become more familiar with verses and their flow.
■ Designed for All Ages
Simple enough for beginners and engaging enough for children, while still valuable for adults looking to deepen their relationship with the Quran.
■ Offline Access
Continue learning and memorizing wherever you are—no internet connection needed.
■ Support Your Daily Worship
Use what you learn to improve your prayer and bring more focus and understanding into your salah.
Consistency is the key to building a strong relationship with the Quran. With the right tools and a steady routine, even small daily efforts can lead to meaningful progress.
► Download the app today and take a step closer to understanding, memorizing, and living the Quran.

bluejetty:00072904:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Draw Happy Police!
It is a game that draws various things and makes people smile.
How much can you help someone in need?
To clear this game, you have to discover why they are in trouble or in a bad mood. Think of something they will be happy with and write it in your own hands.
If your expectations are correct, their dissatisfaction will be resolved and you will smile!
Can you make the police officers happy or struggle? Do you need a clue or a hint?
Are you looking for intuitive easy puzzle games? Save these officers!
They want to live a happy life, so they need your brain! Help them out!
Let’s test your brain! Start drawing now! Save them all!
How to be a Draw Master
1.Relax and solve puzzles
Calm down and find missing issues
Please don't erase anything, but just scribble on the screen
2. Spend long days in the lives of police officers
Over 200 puzzles and so many episodes of missing parts are packed with fun!
Don’t be braindead! Look for clues and hints.
3. You don't have to draw perfectly—no need to be perfect
Enjoy just like you would on a chalkboard.
You need not feel guilty. You will likely have fun when you find the story behind the scenes!
If you like ibis paint, sketchpad, brainpop and happy glass, Draw Happy Police will also be one of your favorite choices. Let's download Draw Happy Police now, and draw something to solve puzzles! Drawing will put a smile to your face and your family!
This game is so easy that it's perfect for your kids to play! People of all ages can play, so let's play with your family and friends and get excited!
Various series of Draw Happy have been released!
There are many other themes such as dentists, Instagrammers, students and criminals. When you finish playing this game, please try other series! If you play, new discoveries and fun will be waiting for you!
Feature functions:

bluejetty:00069354:ios.name: Screen Mirroring MirrorMeister
bluejetty:00069354:ios.summary:
There's no need to use tiny screens, annoying HDMI cables or expensive hardware. Prevent eyestrain, save money and get rid of those unsightly & unsafe cables. Discover MirrorMeister today!
Easily connect your TV to your iOS devices with Mi
bluejetty:00069354:ios.description:
There's no need to use tiny screens, annoying HDMI cables or expensive hardware. Prevent eyestrain, save money and get rid of those unsightly & unsafe cables. Discover MirrorMeister today!
Easily connect your TV to your iOS devices with MirrorMeister's revolutionary app. Totally wireless smartcast of course! Enjoy movies, sport, photos, news and all apps on the big screen and make your life more comfortable.
MirrorMeister is a screen mirroring app that allows you to play the media that’s playing on your phone/ tablet to your smart tv.
- Mirror your phone/ tablet to your smart TV.
- No ugly, clumsy & unsafe cables!
- One app for popular TV brands (Samsung, Sony, LG, Panasonic, Hisense, etc.)
- Watch movies.
- Stream sports.
- Screen mirroring cast to tv.
- Binge-watch series.
- Watch breaking news.
- Show photos to loved-ones and impress friends & family. 
- Cast YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram to TV.
MirrorMeister supports:
1. iPhone & iPad
2. Smart TV: Samsung, Roku TV, Sony, LG, Panasonic, Philips, Grundig, Arçelik, Beko, Hisense, TCL, Toshiba, Sharp, Hitachi, Skyworth, Changhong, and any other TV.
3. Streaming devices: Roku Streaming Player, Chromecast, Amazon FireTV, Xiaomi Mi Box.
Screen Mirroring Advantages:
* Larger screen: 
* Better viewing experience
* Share content with others
* No additional hardware required
* No compatibility issues
* Improved battery life: 
* Easy setup
* Smartview
* Streaming content
* Use as a second display
* High-quality video and audio
INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Make sure that your iPhone or iPad is connected to the same local network as your TV. Don't use multiple VLANs or subnets. 
2. Launch the MirrorMeister app.
3. When you open MirrorMeister for the first time, a simple setup process will guide you step by step on how to connect the mirror app to your TV.
4. To enable sound while screen mirroring, turn down the sound of your iPhone or iPad and turn ON the sound of your TV. Don’t forget to switch OFF the mute button on the side of your iPhone so sound is enabled.
PRIVACY:
Even though there are notifications about Screen Recording, we don’t record your screen into files and we don’t send any content to a server. We only temporarily store data in memory, before it is streamed to the TV. Upon streaming, the content is removed from memory.
Limitations and known issues:
DRM
Some apps don't allow screen mirroring. For instance, iTunes, Netflix, Disney or Apple TV: when you start screen mirroring one of those apps on your iPhone or iPad, the TV screen will turn black. This is a choice that this company made, there is nothing that MirrorMeister can do about it.
Gaming
Please note that our screen mirroring app is not suitable for high-intensity gaming on a Smart TV because of some delay (latency). The delay is normally between 1 and 3 seconds.
Support
If you need any assistance using the mirroring app, please contact us via email or Facebook Messenger. Our support staff is available 24/7 to help you.
UNLIMITED ACCESS PRO SUBSCRIPTION
You need a subscription for unlimited access to all features without advertising and interruptions. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- Terms of use: https://www.mirrormeister.com/terms-of-use/
- Privacy policy: https://www.mirrormeister.com/privacy-policy-meisterapps/

bluejetty:00073784:ios.description:
TroutRoutes by onX is the leading GPS mapping tool for trout streams and fly fishing. As the first mapping tool to offer interactive GPS fishing maps for every trout stream in the continental United States, TroutRoutes provides comprehensive information for each stream and river.
Find local fishing spots, explore new waters, and navigate public access like a pro. View maps of over 50,000 trout streams across 48 states, access 280,000+ hand-curated access points, and view 360 million acres of public land. Forecast with real-time stream conditions, view local regulations, and save detailed maps with your own markups for offline use.
Plan your fly fishing trip with advanced filters and decide what you want to see on the map. View trail access, public or private bridges, parking spots, camping opportunities, boat ramps, and more. Filter rivers by fish species, now available in nine western states.
TroutRoutes is the only App that combines classified trout streams, hand-curated access points, and live USGS stream gauge data in one place. Endorsed by fly fishing professionals and industry partners, find more information in local fly shops such as Orvis.
Access a complete trout fishing tool and start exploring new streams with TroutRoutes.
TroutRoutes by onX Features:
▶ How can I use TroutRoutes to find new streams?
Navigate the map or search bar to find color-coded streams, organized by stream class. With over 50,000 trout streams mapped out across 48 states, TroutRoutes delivers an industry-first national trout quality classification system. Plan your trip based on habitat quality, public access opportunities, and more.
▶ How can I navigate public land and water access?
View information on public and private land and download detailed offline maps. Fish confidently with land boundary data that lets you see exactly where you are as you move upstream, even without cell service. Download maps by river or region, and navigate through fishing easements, national forests, or local parks with GPS mapping.
▶ How can TroutRoutes help me plan my next fly fishing trip?
Set custom markups, filter rivers by species, and navigate new waters with 280,000+ unique and hand-curated public access points. Create personalized maps by adding your points of interest. Filter your map by fish species in CA, WA, OR, MT, WY, CO, UT, ID, and NV.
▶ How can I find the right time and stream to fish?
Access real-time stream conditions and compare historical data to forecast the best times to fish. Get live river flow and chart readings with our USGS gauge layer. See slope and contour details for every stream with interactive elevation charts. Identify tailwater, reservoirs, headwaters, and meadows.
▶ Does TroutRoutes give me access to local regulations and fly fishing shops?
View fly fishing regulations and information on fly shops directly in the App. See color-coded fishing regulations and local stream classes. Locate nearby fly shops and view their website and contact info. Plan ahead with parking locations, bridge access, trailheads, put-ins, and more.
Easy to use for beginners and seasoned pros alike, TroutRoutes takes the guesswork out of fly fishing. Plan your next trout fishing adventure today.
▶ Free Trial: Start a 7-day PRO trial for free when you install the App.
▶ Basic Plan (Free): Multi-platform access across desktop and mobile, a basic view of trout streams, and other limited features.
▶ Single-State ($19.99/year): Full PRO features for one state: classified streams, access points, custom markups, offline maps, and more.
▶ PRO ($39.99/year or $9.99/month): Complete access across 48 states, including:
• 50,000+ classified trout streams
• 280,000+ custom access points
• 360 million acres of public land
• Real-time data, offline maps, fishing regulations
▶ Terms of Use: https://www.onxmaps.com/tou
▶ Privacy Policy: https://www.onxmaps.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00064377:ios.description:
Adopt a dog, adopt a cat, find your forever friend — with WeRescue.
Discover the easiest, most inspiring way to adopt pets near you. With hundreds of thousands of adoptable dogs, cats, puppies, kittens, and more, WeRescue helps you find the right match from shelters and fosters across the U.S. and Canada.
WeRescue is the official pet adoption app trusted by the NBCUniversal Local Clear The Shelters campaign since 2018 — a movement that has helped over 1.3 million pets find homes since 2015. This year's campaign runs August 1–31: explore participating shelters near you, see event days and locations at a glance, and watch the national adoption tracker climb.
MEET WERESCUE SCOUT
Not sure where to start? Chat with Scout. Tell Scout what you're hoping for — adopting, fostering, volunteering, or giving — and Scout builds a plan around your life: real matches from thousands of shelters, rescues that need your kind of help, and helpful reads picked just for you.
Whether you're searching for a playful puppy, a cuddly kitten, or a calm senior companion, WeRescue offers the most powerful filters of any pet adoption app — so you can match with exactly the kind of pet you're looking for.
Search adoptable pets near you, including:
• Dogs and puppies
• Cats and kittens
• Rabbits, reptiles, birds, and barnyard animals
• Small and furry pets like guinea pigs, hamsters, and ferrets
• Horses available for adoption
Key Features:
• Chat with Scout to find pets and shelters that fit your life
• Advanced filters for breed, age, size, color, behavior, gender, distance, and 60 more
• Search by mixed breeds, designer breeds, or specific breeds
• High-resolution pet photos to help you fall in love at first sight
• Local results prioritized — see pets in nearby shelters and foster homes first
• Keep tabs on your favorite shelters and pets
• Share adoptable pets with friends via SMS, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and more — they'll see the exact pet you shared, right in the app
Even if you're not ready to adopt, you can help save lives by sharing pets with others. One post can lead to a forever home.
Join thousands of adopters using WeRescue every day to search, share, and save lives. Whether you're actively looking or just browsing, your next best friend might be one swipe away.
Download WeRescue and be part of something bigger.

bluejetty:00070913:ios.summary:

Bini ABC is home to dozens of games and activities with
bluejetty:00070913:ios.description:
What do you think about playing with the funniest, friendliest, and most adorable letters in the world? Oh, and let’s not forget the majestic and lovely unicorn. Sounds great, right?
Bini ABC is home to dozens of games and activities with these wonderful characters that the whole family is sure to enjoy and benefit from.
Cute living letters are the main characters of this app’s games. With their funny laughter and amusing natures, they will instantly lift everyone’s spirits, help you reboot, and engage the whole family’s attention.
In the Bini ABC app, you’ll:
* Find Value in Play
In the Games Room, there are 14 mini-games and -activities that will help you develop memory, concentration, and coordination. Sharpen your mind and feel your mind expand!
* Interact with Lively Letters
In the Gallery of Letters, you’ll find all the main characters of our app. You can dance with them, run with them, and paint them any way you want. Have fun and get to know your letter friends even better!
* Draw and Relax
There are step-by-step drawing lessons available for you to do at your leisure. Learn to draw animals, elements of nature, and other simple objects. Impress your friends and family with your artistic skills!
* Take the First Steps in Language Learning
In the Learning Path, you can listen to how each letter sounds in a particular language. It’s a great way to get used to unfamiliar pronunciation. Discover the sounds of the world through your device!
* Progress through 17 levels
There are hours of educational entertainment to be had in Bini ABC. Keep the app handy for when you need to take a moment for yourself and relax with a magical Unicorn.
Please note: there is only a part of the content from the screenshots available in the free version of the application. To gain access to the whole content, you need to make the in-app purchase.
Subscription Details
After you subscribe to our app you will get full access to ove learning activities. New added topics and games will be automatically available for all subscribers.
You can have free trial period or can decide to subscribe right after download. We provide different subscription options for your convenience: monthly and annual subscription.
If you change your mind at any point, cancellation is easy through your iTunes settings.
● Payment for subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
● Your Subscription automatically renews unless you turned off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of current period.
● You will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
● You can cancel your subscription anytime through your Account Settings without any cancellation fee.
● You can use your subscription on any device registered with your Apple ID.
● If you need help, have questions or just want to say “hi!”, get in touch at feedback@bini.games
● http://teachdraw.com/terms-of-use/
● http://teachdraw.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00069372:ios.developer: Beijing Xiaoxiong Bowang Technology Co., Ltd.
bluejetty:00069372:ios.summary: DU Recorder is a reliable, and easy-to-use stream creator and screen recorder. With DU Recorder , you can livestream your screen to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch and record screen videos. DU Recorder makes it easy to livestream and record co
bluejetty:00069372:ios.description:
DU Recorder is a reliable, and easy-to-use stream creator and screen recorder. With DU Recorder , you can livestream your screen to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch and record screen videos. DU Recorder makes it easy to livestream and record content from your screen, like games, live shows, sports, and more.
Advantages: 
- Support audio recording
- Livestream your screen to different platforms
- High-quality screen recording
- Powerful video editing features
Features:
Livestream to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch
Add the screen recording feature to your control center. Simply log in to your YouTube, Facebook and Twitch account, choose the settings as you want, and start livestreaming to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch via the screen recording feature! These handy options give you a better livestreaming experience:
- Support simultaneous recording of microphone and internal audio
- High-quality livestreaming, with various resolution options
- Set your livestream to public, unlisted, or private to protect privacy
- Supports RTMP address
- A variety of live tools: Custom watermark, live themes, live pause settings and more
- Supports Replaykit, for livestreaming directly from Replaykit-compatible games
Screen Recording
Add the screen recording feature to your control center, tap the Record button, and choose DU Recorder to record your screen and save videos to your device. DU Recorder provides stable and fluid screen recording. With this screen recording feature, you can easily record popular mobile game videos, video calls with family and friends, and even popular live shows!
Video Editing
You can easily perform the following video editing operations with the screen recorder:
- Trim video/Remove the middle part of the video
- Add music, choose from a huge variety of music
- Add text, custom video subtitles
- Add frames and stickers, also support adding local images and custom watermark to your videos
- Change speed, adjust video speed of different sections
- Voice recording, help you make a commentary video
- Filters, add a variety of filter effects to your video
- Crop video, crop videos to any ratio you want
- Merge multiple videos and choose from various transition effects
- Video to GIF, convert video formats to GIF
- Supports facecam, you can record reaction videos with the facecam feature
DU Recorder Premium
- Join now and enjoy all the features! 
- Included features：Remove watermark, Custom watermark, Custom pause picture, Speed, Crop, RTMP broadcast, VIP feedback channel and more wonderful content.
- When you purchase DU Recorder Premium, you will use all paid features and materials. 
- DU Recorder Premium is billed monthly or annually at the rate corresponding to the selected plan. 
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. 
- According to the Apple Store policy, your subscription will be automatically renewed after the free trial ends. 
- Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of current period. 
- Your account will be charged according to your plan for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings at any time after purchase. 
- Privacy policy: http://durecorder.do-global.com/privacy/privacyPolicy.html
- Terms of use: http://durecorder.do-global.com/privacy/UserAgreement.html
If you have any comments or suggestions about DU Recorder, please contact us at durecorderlive@gmail.com. Your feedback is appreciated!
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DURecorderOfficial
Subscribe to our YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtvNkr4kV3GAEHAFqe5UocQ
