bluejetty:00092652:ios.description:
Office management game: grow business & make money in idle tycoon empire game!
Tired of boring idle games? In Office Life!, you're the boss(CEO)—hire employees, upgrade your office, and build your dream company from scratch.
Manage workflows, automate tasks, and watch your startup grow into a global business empire.
Make smart decisions, invest wisely, and become the richest office tycoon in town.
Whether you're into
idle, simulation, management, or hypercasual games, this one’s got you covered—even when you're offline.
▶Run & Manage a Full Office Simulation 
Take charge of key departments—HR, development, finance, and more. Monitor performance, assign roles, and fine-tune your business strategy.
Learn how to keep your office running efficiently by managing employee energy, reducing bottlenecks, and optimizing workflows with smart upgrades. A happy employee performs better—your people are your power.
Grow your startup into a powerful company headquarters, floor by floor. Expand your business operations with strategic planning and departmental resources. Your HQ will become the heart of your expanding empire.
▶ Hire Managers & Upgrade Facilities 
As the boss, recruit skilled employees and place specialized managers to automate tasks
Upgrade your facilities—desks, equipment, décor, and common areas—to lift employee morale and drive better business results, even offline.
Customize each workspace to suit your team’s needs and unlock greater productivity.
Make high-impact decisions: recruit the right people, assign tasks smartly, and invest in your growing company infrastructure. Empower each department to function like a well-oiled machine.
▶ Expand & Customize Your Corporate 
Start with a single startup floor and transform it into a towering business complex. Unlock new departments, build out functional rooms, and launch global company branches.
Redesign your office layout, move teams for efficiency, and use space wisely to boost your management simulation experience.
Build your company from the ground up with precision, vision, and true office tycoon tactics—your HQ should reflect your leadership style.
▶ Free to Play – No Wi-Fi Needed 
Play anytime, anywhere. No Wi-Fi needed. Your office team keeps working while you’re away, earning money and growing your business.
Designed for smooth performance across all devices—even low-end phones. Perfect for casual players and business sim enthusiasts.
Whether you’re optimizing a local branch or expanding a multinational enterprise, Office Life keeps the idle progress going.
▶ Download the App and Become the CEO of a Growing Empire 
Start your journey as a bold startup founder and rise to the top as a powerful CEO.
Build a scalable, high-performing company, make key management decisions, and enjoy the thrill of growing a thriving business empire.
Become the office manager, the strategist, the leader—build the company you’ve always dreamed of. Your business adventure tycoon starts now.

bluejetty:00023505:ios.description:
GtrLib Chords – The Ultimate Guitar Chord Library
Unlock the full potential of your guitar playing with GtrLib Chords, the most comprehensive and easy-to-use chord reference for guitarists of all levels. Whether you're just starting out and need a reliable guide to essential chords or you're an advanced player looking to explore complex voicings and inversions, this app provides everything you need to learn, practice, and master guitar chords with confidence and precision.
With an extensive library of thousands of chords, including multiple voicings, suggested finger positions, and audio demonstrations, this app provides everything you need to expand your chord vocabulary and improve your playing.
Key Features:
Comprehensive Chord Library
• Explore a vast collection of chords in every key, including major, minor, diminished, augmented, suspended, extended, and more.
• View all possible chord variations, inversions, and positions across the fretboard.
• Learn chord placements from the open position to the highest frets.
Learn & Play with Confidence
• Suggested fingerings to improve technique and efficiency.
• Audio playback to hear how every chord sounds before playing.
• Fretboard visualization for better understanding of chord structures.
Quick Search & Instant Access
• Built-in search to find any chord instantly.
• Spotlight search integration to locate chords directly from your device.
Customize Your Experience
• Left-handed mode for left-handed guitarists.
• Key switching to transpose chords effortlessly.
• Dark mode support for a visually comfortable experience.
Export, Share & Save
• Export chords as PNG or MIDI files for easy reference or music production.
• Use exported MIDI files in DAWs like GarageBand, Logic Pro, Ableton Live, and FL Studio.
• Print or share chords with students, bandmates, or collaborators.
Designed for Everyone
• VoiceOver accessibility for visually impaired users.
• User-friendly interface for smooth navigation and ease of use.
Who Is GtrLib Chords For?
• Beginners – Learn fundamental chords with clear diagrams and audio playback.
• Intermediate & advanced guitarists – Explore complex voicings, inversions, and extended chords.
• Songwriters & composers – Quickly find the perfect chord for any song.
• Guitar teachers & students – Use it as a reliable teaching and learning tool.
• Producers & musicians – Integrate MIDI chord files into music production.
Why Choose GtrLib Chords?
Unlike generic chord books or basic online chord finders, GtrLib Chords provides:
• A massive, well-organized chord library with multiple variations.
• Fingering recommendations to improve accuracy.
• Audio demonstrations to help you recognize chords by ear.
• Offline access for anytime, anywhere learning.
• High-quality exports for musicians, songwriters, and educators.
Download GtrLib Chords Today!
Discover a powerful, easy-to-use tool designed for guitarists of all levels. Whether you're practicing, performing, or composing, GtrLib Chords will help you unlock the full potential of your guitar playing.
Get started now and take your guitar skills to the next level!

bluejetty:00083367:ios.summary: Welcome to Farm Merge, a casual game that combines planting, collecting, merging, and fighting. Here, you'll meet a group of friends with different personalities and unique experiences, and build a farm with them. Plant crops, fulfill order
bluejetty:00083367:ios.description:
Welcome to Farm Merge, a casual game that combines planting, collecting, merging, and fighting. Here, you'll meet a group of friends with different personalities and unique experiences, and build a farm with them. Plant crops, fulfill orders, raise various cute animals, and enjoy the fun of pastoral life. As your farm grows, You'll also unlock buildings such as railway stations and ports, participate in crop trade, and bring further development to the farm. Turn yourself into a boss, making this place more and more bustling!
Now, let's forget about the tired and hectic life for a while, and start a decompression and healing farm journey!
Game Features:
-The farm is rich in products, hundreds of illustrated book items, a wide variety, unlock as much as you want.
-Merging 3 identical items can be upgraded to a higher level; Merging 5 identical items will be even more cost-effective.
-Merging cute pets can get more hearts and unlock more land.
-Buy seeds, plant, fertilize, irrigate, and experience happy planting.
-Summon cute animals to gather supplies and build workshops, complete orders from NPC, train and cruise, and strive for more profits.
-Match the lineup reasonably, send cute pets into other players' farms, launch attacks, and start battles to snatch resources. Have you been attacked? Launch a counterattack at any time, crush them with strength.
-Add friends and chat anytime or visit his farm. Chat in real time with all players in the game, share your gameplay experience.

bluejetty:00098090:android.description:
Awaken your survival instinct - Let's fight!
INTRODUCTION
Food Land - Survival is an action role-playing, shooting, hand-to-hand fight, time-based survival, adventure game with roguelite elements. This is a survival game with a completely new storyline, different from other kinds of survival. Besides overly familiar topics such as shooting zombies or fantasy creatures, Food Land - Survival offers a story that is both intimate and novel about the battle of food heroes with insects.
Nowhere else to run or hide, the only choice is to fight to survive.
PLOT
Our food friends have been arrested by the zombies. The insects and vermin are gathering to attack. They had the ambition of devouring it all. 
It is an emergency, let’s fight now!
Become a hero of chivalry, survive and take the responsibility of surviving to achieve a heroic end. You will play as food characters and survive through the battle by killing all vermin. Red pepper - Charlie survivor, Pumpkin - Jack survivor, Banana - Bart survivor, Brotato Bob survivor, ... Each character has different powers and strengths, choose a favorite character for yourself and destroy zombie enemies with powerful weapons in your survival fight.
HOW TO PLAY
Control the character with joystick, the character's weapons will automatically attack the nearest enemy. Remaining survival for a given period of time, you will pass the game. After eliminating all the monsters and vermin at each stage, your character will gain experience and level up. When the zombie enemies are destroyed, there are hero coins that will be automatically collected at the end of the survival day. Use the accumulated coins to equip and upgrade the most advanced weapons. Besides, pay attention to your HP bar to prolong your survival because it won’t be regenerated.
FEATURE
1. Variety of characters with different kinds of power
There are different classes of food heroes who will join in this survival battle. You can choose to become pumpkin hero - Jack survivor with damage resistance, banana hero - Bart survivor with variable speed movement ability, pepper hero - Charlie survivor with powerful damage resistance,… Dozens of survival characters with distinguished abilities await your discovery.
2. Diversity of weapons, combine them to deal higher damage.
Choose to use high-damage weapons such as crossbows, bows, darts, shotguns, bazoka,... Or defend yourself with everyday items like fists, rocks, boxing, etc. You can use up to 6 weapons at the same time to survive the crowd. Playing with Boomerang survival, Kunai survival, Mystic Harp survival, Lightsaber survival,… hundreds of remarkable weapons. Upgrade through battles, combine and reinforce different skills, and fight your way to be the strongest in the survival game!
3. Surviving through a swarming mob of zombie insects by destroying them all
Through the survival battle, the more the crowd vermin zombie, the more formidable they are. Be always careful, especially with the last zombie bosses and their fury.
4. Multiple items to help you increase your in-game survival
Bonus little gifts in the game will randomly fall out, instant immunity, instant coin magnet, speed-up movement help you maintain your enduring fighting power in survival combat.
5. Lively shooting sound combined with fantasy background music.
Starting with "Food Land - Survival" - Fight alone, survive to be unstoppable!
Food Land - Survival is one of many free games created by TQC. If you are into playing survival games, simulation games, running games, free games, popular games, try Food Land - Survival.
We aim to be the leading popular game company, creating fun free games, simulator games and compelling role-playing games.
In the future, we will try our best to bring you more game modes including infinity mode and multiplayer mode for you and your friends to fight together.
Share your survival fighting gameplay and comments - we'd love to hear your opinion!

bluejetty:00022502:ios.description:
Welcome to RAID & RUSH! Assemble a team of heroes, set out on an adventure, and fight to protect your gold in an action-packed strategy RPG!
Brave Knights, deadly Archers, powerful Mages, and other unique heroes are ready for battle and await your command. Build your squad, plan your formation, and don't let the enemy reach your cart full of gold!
CLASSIC ADVENTURE:
● Assemble a squad of unique heroes with different abilities and fighting styles.
● Position your heroes around the gold cart, plan your strategy, and fight off waves of incoming enemies.
● Protect your gold at all costs! The more gold reaches the finish line, the more stars you earn.
● Explore new lands, complete levels, and battle Orcs, Dragons, and other dangerous enemies.
● Open chests, unlock new heroes, and grow stronger with every adventure.
● Replay completed levels, change your strategy, and fight for the maximum reward.
HEROES & STRATEGY:
● Collect heroes of different classes and create your own powerful battle combinations.
● Upgrade your heroes, improve their abilities, and make your squad even stronger.
● Experiment with team compositions and formations — sometimes putting the right hero in the right place can change the entire battle.
● Adapt your strategy to different enemies and powerful bosses.
● Build a team capable of taking on any challenge!
PvP & COMPETITION:
● Enter the Arena and battle other players in exciting PvP fights.
● Defend your gold and attack your opponent — put your strategy to the test and fight for victory.
● Win battles, increase your rating, and advance through the Leagues.
● Climb the leaderboards and prove your squad belongs among the best.
● Take part in tournaments and competitions and fight for valuable rewards.
CLANS:
● Join a Clan and find allies among players from around the world.
● Fight alongside your Clanmates and help your Clan grow stronger.
● Challenge powerful bosses and take part in Clan Battles.
● Compete against other Clans and lead your Clan to the top of the rankings.
MORE WAYS TO BATTLE:
● Put your heroes to the test across different PvE and PvP game modes.
● Enter the Marathon and see how far your squad can go.
● Complete daily tasks and earn extra rewards.
● Open chests, collect rewards, and keep building a stronger team.
● Join special events — there's always a new reason to jump back into battle in RAID & RUSH!
What are you waiting for, hero? Assemble your squad, get ready to defend your gold, and begin your adventure in RAID & RUSH!

COMPREHENSIVE AVIATION REGULA
bluejetty:00027151:ios.description:
A comprehensive, easy-to-use FAR/AIM with powerful search, personalized regulation filters, and advanced annotations. Try any subscription free for one month, or purchase lifetime access with a single payment.
COMPREHENSIVE AVIATION REGULATIONS
▸ All of Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations, including Parts 1, 43, 48, 61, 65, 67, 68, 71, 73, 91, 97, 103, 105, 107, 110, 117, 119, 121, 135, 136, 137, 141, and 142.
▸ Title 49 Parts 172 and 175 (HazMat), 830 (NTSB), and 1544 and 1552 (TSA).
▸ Every section of the FAA Aeronautical Information Manual (AIM), including the original figures.
▸ The complete Pilot/Controller Glossary.
▸ Updated regularly with the latest content.
FARs FILTERED FOR YOUR USE CASE
▸ Filter regulations by use case: General Aviation, Sport Pilot, Private Pilot, Instrument Rating, Commercial Pilot, Flight Instructor, Flight Crew, Remote Pilot, or Maintenance.
▸ Your selected filter applies to FAR lists, search results, and the Next and Previous buttons in the reader. Choose All Regulations to see everything.
POWERFUL SEARCH
▸ Search every document at once, or limit a search to the FAR, AIM, Pilot/Controller Glossary, NTSB, HazMat, or TSA.
▸ Search exact phrases using quotation marks, combine terms with OR, and exclude terms with a minus sign.
▸ Narrow searches to a specific FAR Part, section titles, or whole words.
▸ Search results include preview lines with matching terms highlighted.
▸ Sort results by relevance or document order.
▸ Matches within the section you’re reading appear first and are highlighted on the page. Navigate between matches one by one (iOS 17.2 and later).
ANNOTATIONS
▸ Bookmark any section, add notes, and highlight text in five colors.
▸ Give sections custom names and organize them with color tags.
▸ Manage all annotations in one place, with filters for type, document, or tag.
▸ Automatically sync annotations across your Apple devices using iCloud.
▸ Optionally create a FlightReady account to back up your bookmarks, notes, highlights, tags, and reading history and keep them synchronized across devices.
MORE FEATURES
▸ Reading history organized by day.
▸ Email, print, or share any FAR section, AIM paragraph, or glossary definition.
▸ Adjustable text size with support for iOS Dynamic Type.
▸ Light and dark themes, or automatic switching to match your system settings.
▸ Portrait and landscape orientations, with multitasking support on iPad.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Start with a free one-month trial on any subscription. Free trials automatically convert to paid subscriptions unless canceled before the trial ends.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. To cancel a subscription or free trial, open Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions. You can also manage subscriptions in the App Store by tapping your profile picture and selecting Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
All FAR/AIM content comes from public sources, including the Federal Aviation Administration and the Government Publishing Office.

Privacy Policy: https://www.flightready.net/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00087826:ios.description:
SportNinja is the leading real-time Digital Scoring and streaming app, providing live updates to players, league 
officials and followers. A comprehensive suite of League and Team Management functionality in a single, integrated platform on web and mobile.
Steps to get started (as a Player / Team Rep / Official): 
1. Download the SportNinja app. It’s FREE for participants
2. Click the invitation email (which you will receive from your team/ league via SportNinja) and follow the steps to Join. 
3. OR, track teams and competitions by searching and starring, using the Following tab.
Steps to get started (as a League Owner / Admin):
1. Download the SportNinja app and create an Account.
2. Log into the Web platform www.sportninja.com to complete your organization set up.
3. Invite Team Reps, Officials, Players in with the appropriate roles,, to download and join their teams, etc..
We are continuously working to improve the app with updates and new features. We would love to hear your feedback - info@sportninja.com.

bluejetty:00042017:ios.name: Weight Loss Bet by HealthyWage
bluejetty:00042017:ios.summary: Win up to $10,000 by making a "bet" on your own weight loss, or by participating in one of our many weight loss and fitness challenges. There’s a reason we paid out millions to our participants last year - our challenges are fun, effective,
bluejetty:00042017:ios.description:
Win up to $10,000 by making a "bet" on your own weight loss, or by participating in one of our many weight loss and fitness challenges. There’s a reason we paid out millions to our participants last year - our challenges are fun, effective, and people love to win money for losing weight!
According to one of our participants, “HealthyWage has flipped on a switch that I just couldn’t seem to get clicked on by myself. Not sure, or what science is behind it, but this...is astounding!”
Time and again, we've provided participants with the motivation to get healthier that they've been searching for. In fact, 45% of our participants report weight loss¹ when participating in a HealthyWage Challenge, with an average prize payout of $1,386². Oh, and we DO know the science behind it. We’re kind of nerdy like that!
Check out some of the features you’ll enjoy with the HealthyWage app:
- Take and post-victory and before-and-after photos
- Participate with a vibrant community for support and accountability
- Keep track of your weight loss and your progress toward hitting your goal (and winning money!)
- Track your step activity throughout the day
- Create and submit your beginning and ending weigh-in verification videos
- Access your winnings to cash out or begin another challenge
- Keep an eye on your standing among other players
- Build friendships, get inspired by others success, and practice your best cheerleading skills
- Easily find and enter new challenges
There are 4 different types of HealthyWage Challenges you can join through the app. Those are:
The HealthyWager
Win up to $10,000 in an individual weight loss bet. Set the terms using the Prize Calculator (you choose your weight loss goal, wager amount, etc.). Play with the calculator all you like without commitment.
$10,000 Team Challenge
Teams of five compete to win cash prizes -- first prize is $10,000.
Jackpot Challenges
Individuals and teams try to achieve specific weight loss goals to earn a share of the pot.
Step Challenge
Individuals and teams connect step devices to calculate a custom goal. Achieve the step goal and earn a share of the pot! Devices available: Apple Health (Apple phones and watches via HealthKit), Garmin and Fitbit.
HealthyWage's weight loss challenges have been featured on the Today show, Good Morning America, CNN, ABC News, NBC News, Fox News, and in The Wall Street Journal & The New York Times.
From our participants:

bluejetty:00087109:ios.name: Clippit: AI Text To Speech
bluejetty:00087109:ios.summary: Turn any PDF, article, note, or screenshot into audio you can listen to anywhere. Clippit is a powerful text-to-speech app that transforms your reading list into a personal, podcast‑style listening experience, perfect for commutes, workouts
bluejetty:00087109:ios.description:
Turn any PDF, article, note, or screenshot into audio you can listen to anywhere. Clippit is a powerful text-to-speech app that transforms your reading list into a personal, podcast‑style listening experience, perfect for commutes, workouts, or study sessions.
Clippit doesn’t just read text aloud. It turns your content into natural, conversational audio that feels like your favorite podcast.
"Clippit revolutionized how I consume content. Instead of spending hours reading, I can now listen during my commute or walk to college." - Elliot G.
WHY LISTEN INSTEAD OF READ?
Clippit helps you reclaim your time and stay on top of what matters by turning any text into engaging audio:
- Study smarter: Convert lecture notes, slides, and online study guides into a podcast-style review.
- Stay informed on the go: Turn long-form articles, reports, and newsletters into audio you can listen to hands-free.
Audio learning has been shown to improve retention, save time, and enable true multitasking. Clippit makes that accessible for anything you read.
WHAT MAKES CLIPPIT DIFFERENT?
Most text-to-speech apps sound robotic and monotonous. Clippit gives you:
- Podcast-style conversations: Your content is synthesized into a back-and-forth between multiple speakers, so it feels like you’re listening to a real show.
- Voices inspired by your favorite hosts: Choose from different voice styles and tones to match the kind of podcast you love.
- Smart synthesis: Clippit doesn’t just read text; it summarizes and structures it into a more listenable, flowing conversation.
WHAT OUR COMMUNITY IS SAYING
"I love the way the app turns my study notes and class readings into entertaining podcasts while emulating my favourite podcast online" - Emily M.
"I started using NotebookLM, but when I found this app it made it so much easier to listen to content on the go. It does a great job synthesizing the content uploaded and creates a very listenable conversation" - Jennifer S.
"It’s so funny to create podcast clips that sound like Joe Rogan and Alex Cooper" - Daniel Z.
"It’s so much easier to listen to a podcast version of my notes and online study guides to help me study" - Sam R.
FEATURES
- Intelligent Content Import: Easily import PDFs, articles, notes, screenshots, and links. Clippit’s smart content recognition pulls out the text and gets it ready for audio.
- 2-Speaker Conversation Style: Turn dry text into a dynamic two-speaker conversation. Choose from a variety of voice styles inspired by popular podcasters and adjust the duration of each episode.

WHY LISTEN INSTEAD OF READ?

Clippit helps you reclaim your time and stay on top of what matters by turning any text into engaging audio:
- Study smarter: Convert lecture notes, slides, and online study guides into a podcast-style review.
- Stay informed on the go: Turn long-form articles, reports, and newsletters into audio you can listen to hands-free.

Audio learning has been shown to improve retention, save time, and enable true multitasking. Clippit makes that accessible for anything you read.

WHAT MAKES CLIPPIT DIFFERENT?

- Voices inspired by your favorite hosts: Choose from different voice styles and tones to match the kind of podcast you love.
- Smart synthesis: Clippit doesn’t just read text; it summarizes and structures it into a more listenable, flowing conversation.

bluejetty:00045108:ios.description:
Transform any occasion into an unforgettable adventure with Scavos! Whether for birthdays, events, or just casual fun, Scavos offers engaging scavenger hunts you can create or join with friends. Packed with puzzles, photo challenges, and real-time leaderboards, it’s all about having a blast together.
*New Adventure Assistant*
Introducing the Adventure Assistant: Instantly create a scavenger hunt by answering a few questions! Adventure Assistant generates ~20 unique missions, a catchy title, description, and a fun cover photo—making it easier than ever to jump into the action.
Key Features:
- Adventure Assistant: Quickly create custom hunts with AI-generated missions based on your input.
- Play Anywhere: Host hunts at any location or remotely, allowing players to join from different places.
- Photo & Video Missions: Capture moments to complete challenges with a real-time leaderboard to track progress.
- Riddle & Quiz Missions: Add a twist to your hunt with riddle and quiz challenges that engage players' problem-solving skills.
- Photo-Enhanced Prompts: Attach images to prompts, enabling missions like "recreate this pose" or "find this landmark."
- Quest & Scramble Modes: Complete missions in order with 'Quest' mode, or tackle them in any order with 'Scramble' mode.
- Mission Gallery: Browse all photos and videos captured during the hunt, organized by mission, and download them as a .zip file.
- Compete or Collaborate: Choose competitive or collaborative gameplay to match your group’s mood.
- Quick Comments: Instantly comment on submissions to keep the fun going.
- Tours: Discover professionally designed scavenger hunts that mix guided walking tours with escape-room-style puzzles.
- Player Slots & Player Packs: Each game has 3 free Player Slots. Purchase additional slots through the "Player Pack" in-app purchase to allow more players to join.
Download Scavos today and start exploring!

bluejetty:00072899:ios.description:
Create your own characters, dress them your way, and design rooms full of personality in Beauty World!
Mix your favorite outfits, experiment with hairstyles, and decorate spaces that match your style. From a cozy bedroom to a colorful living room, every creation starts with your ideas.
• CREATE YOUR CHARACTERS
Customize skin tones, hairstyles, facial features, and more. Make each character look different and discover new combinations with the random look button.
• MIX AND MATCH OUTFITS
Explore clothes, shoes, hats, and accessories. Put together a playful everyday look or dress up for a special occasion. Change colors on supported clothing to add your own touch.
• DESIGN YOUR ROOMS
Choose wall colors, patterns, and flooring, then arrange furniture and decorations. Add plants, rugs, lamps, and little details to make each room feel like yours.
• SAVE AND KEEP CREATING
Save your characters and rooms, revisit your favorites, and edit them whenever inspiration strikes. Try a different outfit, rearrange the furniture, or start a fresh design.
Whether you love fashion, character creation, or decorating, Beauty World gives you space to explore your ideas.
Your characters. Your rooms. Your style.

bluejetty:00087299:ios.summary:
This app helps you discover and choose the perfect color palettes for your wardrobe, outfits, and makeup, based on your natural features like skin tone, hair color, and eye color, while also considering the latest fashion trends.
Colors c
bluejetty:00087299:ios.description:
This app helps you discover and choose the perfect color palettes for your wardrobe, outfits, and makeup, based on your natural features like skin tone, hair color, and eye color, while also considering the latest fashion trends.
Colors can be warm, neutral, cool, soft, saturated, light, or dark. Every person has unique physical attributes, such as skin tone, eye color, and hair color. That’s why not all colors suit everyone equally well. Some shades may look average on one person but brilliant on another.
Complete the Seasonal Color Analysis quiz and explore palettes that are in perfect harmony with your skin, hair, and eyes.
It supports all 12 color seasons from Warm Spring and Cool Summer to Soft Autumn and Deep Winter helping you find your perfect palette with precision.
Also available on Apple Watch, quickly browse your seasonal palettes anytime, anywhere.
Key Features:
- Over 4,500 outfit and makeup color suggestions
- Outfit palettes for each seasonal type: best and trend colors, full color range, combinations, and neutrals
- Additional outfit palettes: business wear, special occasion looks, accessories, jewelry, sunglasses color tips, and colors to avoid
- Makeup palettes: lipsticks, eyeshadows, eyeliners, blushes, and eyebrow colors
- Each color can be viewed on a full-display page
- Seasonal Color Analysis quiz
- Detailed descriptions of each color type
- Custom color cards via the “Favorite Colors” feature
If you experience any issues with the app, please don’t hesitate to contact us, we’ll be glad to help.

bluejetty:00066414:ios.description:
Explore, buy, and unlock the best of Nike, Jordan, and Converse. SNKRS is more than a shoes shopping app - giving sneakerheads insider access to the latest launches featuring exclusive sneakers and streetwear apparel. 
SNKRS FEATURES
STAY A STEP AHEAD
* Shop sneakers and streetwear: Buy the latest sneaker styles and trending women’s and men’s clothing
* Set Notifications: Stay updated with the latest sneaker news, releases, and exclusive stories. View upcoming drops and prepare for the streetwear you want most – from the latest shoes to trending apparel.
* Reserve Sneakers with SNKRS Pass: Secure your pair with SNKRS and pick it up at your nearest shoe store for a seamless launch day experience
* Get Exclusive Access: Get rewarded with invite-only launches to some of the most coveted women’s and men’s clothing and sneaker styles.
* Catch Surprise Drops: Be ready for a range of unique launch scavenger hunts – access might be hidden in geo-located events, scannable augmented reality targets or scratch-able images
EXPLORE THE COMMUNITY
* View Exclusive SNKRS Stories: Learn about the inspiration and heritage behind your favorite streetwear styles and sneakers. Access untold tales from the SNKRS community
* Vote on Polls: Have your voice heard in the sneaker community by answering questions that inform everything from future products to experiences and content
* Watch SNKRS Live: Tune in for the latest sneaker news on exclusive collabs and upcoming releases. Catch SNKRS livestreams and join the conversation with live polling, never heard stories, the inside scoop, and more
* Discover SNKRS Maps: Whether you’re traveling to a new city or exploring your local neighborhood, SNKRS Maps is with you. Visit local sneaker stores, community spaces and events near you.
HOW TO GET STARTED
* Sign up or log in with your Nike account
* Save your correct name, size, and shipping address under your profile so you are ready for
launch day
* Start shopping and discover fresh streetwear apparel and sneakers
Join the community today.

bluejetty:00070258:ios.description:
Are you in search of a new moto simulator bike tour game?
Do you want a moto bike driving simulator that offers multiple game modes besides a traffic tour & highway racing?
Meet Motor Tour, a new endless arcade racing game that takes you to another level of smooth driving simulations and high-quality graphics. Enjoy mesmerizing motor simulator & gameplay that skyrockets the thrill when racing motorcycles and other vehicles on the road. Real bike traffic racing has a new meaning with Motor Tour.
Drive your motorbike in the endless highway roads, overtake traffic in challenging career missions, collect blueprints, unlock new motorcycles, upgrade them, and challenge your friends in a real-time racing motorcycle multiplayer.
► REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER RACING (PvP)
Racing alone on the moto highway is super-fun. But if you want true adventure and adrenaline-pump enter the multiplayer moto simulator races.
- Choose your best motorcycle and challenge other players in real-time
- Join 100 different online missions and get prizes by beating your opponents
- Send motor traffic tour race requests and challenge your friends
► 5 GAME MODES
Unlike other moto highway real bike games, Motor Tour gives you tons of choices to enjoy racing in the motor world. From bike traffic highway racing and endless motor driving, to racing motorcycles in battles and real bike racing racer challenges, the true moto bike driving simulator fans are set for the maximum excitement.
► CREATE YOUR MOTORCYCLE EMPIRE
In our drive ride motorcycle racing game, you can also become the fastest moto highway rider by owning upgrading your motorbikes and enlarging your collection of motorcycles by collecting blue prints. Meaning besides ktm bike riding, bikers can enjoy customizing & create their very own top motorcycle collection to become unbeatable in the bike racing challenges.
► KEY FEATURES OF OUR MOTOR TOUR BIKE RACE:
- Unlimited Play - No Fuel or Time Limits
- Multiple Control Modes: Tilt, Buttons, or Steering Wheel
- 5 Game Play Modes: Multiplayer, Endless, Career, Time Trial, Free Run
- 100 Missions in Career Mode
- 5 Realistic Environments: Day, Sunset, and Night
- 40 Different Motorcycles with the Ability for Customization
- Unlock Motorcycles by Collecting or Buying Blueprints
- Upgrade Motorcycle Features: Power, Handling, and Brakes
- Variety of Traffic Vehicles: Trucks, Buses, Vans, Pickups, SUVs
- Multiplayer Racing, Challenging Friends and Players from All Around the World.

bluejetty:00084569:ios.description:
VoiceTra is a speech translation app that translates your speech into different languages.
VoiceTra supports 33 languages and can be downloaded and used for free. With an easy-to-use interface, you can also check if the translation results are correct.
VoiceTra, whether to enhance your travel experience or to welcome visitors to Japan, will definitely come in handy as your personal speech translator.
■Features:
VoiceTra utilizes high-precision speech recognition, translation, and speech synthesis technologies developed by the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT). It translates your spoken words into different languages and outputs the results in a synthesized voice.
The translation direction can be instantly switched, allowing 2 people that speak different languages to communicate using a single device.
Text input is available for languages that do not support speech input.
VoiceTra is best suited for travel-related conversations and is recommended for situations and places such as below:
・Transportation: Bus, train, rent-a-car, taxi, airport, transit
・Shopping: Restaurant, shopping, payment
・Hotel: Check-in, check out, cancellation
・Sightseeing: Overseas travel, serving and supporting foreign customers
*VoiceTra has also been introduced as a disaster-prevention, disaster-related app.
While VoiceTra can be used as a dictionary to look up words, it is recommended to input sentences as it interprets the meaning from the context to output the translation results.
■Supported languages:
Japanese, English, Chinese (simplified), Chinese (traditional), Korean, Thai, French, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Spanish, Myanmar, Arabic, Italian, Ukrainian, Urdu, Dutch, Khmer, Sinhala, Tamil, Danish, German, Turkish, Nepali, Hungarian, Hindi, Filipino, Bengali, Polish, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Malay, Mongolian, Lao, and Russian
■Restrictions, etc.:
Internet connection is required.
It may take a while to display the translation results depending on the network connectivity.
Languages available for text input are those that the OS keyboard supports.
The characters may not be displayed properly if the appropriate font is not installed on your device.
Please note that some of the functions or the application itself may be disabled when the server is down.
Users are responsible for the communication fees incurred to use the application. Please be aware that international data roaming charges can be expensive.
This application was developed for research purposes; targeting individuals to test it out when traveling, and uses servers that are also setup for research purposes. The data recorded on the server will be utilized to make improvements in speech translation technologies.
You may test out the app for businesses, etc., but please consider using private services that we have licensed our technology to for continuous use.
Please refer to our "Terms of Use" for further details → https://voicetra.nict.go.jp/en/attention.html

bluejetty:00073435:ios.description:
Dissatisfied with your music provider or want to try something new?
SongShift transfers the music you love to the music provider you want. Shift your favorite playlists, songs, and albums with a few taps.
How it works:
- Connect your music services
- Configure which music you'd like to transfer
- SongShift finds suitable matches
- Confirm our song matches and fix any we may have gotten wrong
- The rest is magic. Sit back and let SongShift transfer your music
***
Supported Services:
- Apple Music*
- Amazon Music
- Audiomack
- Deezer
- Discogs
- HypeMachine
- Last.fm
- Pandora
- Qobuz
- SoundCloud
- Spotify
- TIDAL
- YouTube
* An active Apple Music subscription is required to transfer music into Apple Music.
***
Key Features:
- Quickly Shift your favorite music between services
- Match review makes it a breeze to transfer the exact music you want
- Add many transfers to the queue with batch setup
- Add new Shifts using a web link copied to the clipboard
- Monitor playlists for new song additions to keep your transferred playlists up to date
- Browse your connected music libraries, add songs to playlists, and edit playlist titles and descriptions where supported
- Use Siri and Shortcuts to open music links, find songs on another service, save music to your library, add songs to playlists, and find your last played song
- Share your playlists with SongMix, our music-sharing app
- Keep your recently played music close at hand with Home Screen widgets
- A refreshed design with glass elements and iPhone Duo support
- Available in 31 languages, with accessibility features and support for right-to-left layouts
***
If you have any issues with SongShift, please let us know at support@songshift.com. We'll be happy to assist in any way we can.
SongShift’s Terms & Conditions are available at https://songshift.com/terms.

bluejetty:00027263:ios.description:
Save storage space on your iPhone or iPad by compressing your photos and reducing their size without reducing their quality. 
6 REASONS TO USE COMPRESS PHOTOS
- Save space on your iPhone or iPad by reducing photos file size
- Optimized for best image quality possible
- Shrink photos to share them faster with friends and family
- Quickly compress photos before posting them to social media
- Very easy to use
- Highly rated with an average of 4.5 stars
REVIEWS FROM USERS
"Thank God for this app. It is easy to use. Does what it says. And gives great results." by mazmac747
"Tested with 2 images that took up 18 Mb reduced to 0.68 Mb and clear. Works great." by Capt Jack Sparrow POTC
"Absolutely brilliant Application that speedily compresses your photos for storage, sharing and export. Thanks!" by Rebsolar
SAVE SPACE ON YOUR iPHONE
Are you plagued by the “Storage almost full” alert on your iPhone or iPad? If so, this app can help! 
Use Compress Photos to shrink the file size of photos and regain storage space on your device. When applied to all your pictures, Compress Photos can help you store up to 10 times more photos on your iPhone or iPad.
KEEP IMAGE QUALITY SHARP
Compress Photos is easy to use but it is incredibly powerful. 
The intelligent compression engine allows you to reduce the file size of photos without reducing their quality. With two compression settings to choose from, Compress Photos can easily shrink photos by 90% or more without a notable difference.
EASILY LOCATE COMPRESSED PHOTOS
Compressed photos are saved to both your main library and a dedicated album conveniently called “Compressed Photos” on your device, allowing you to easily locate processed pictures. This new album is automatically created when you run the app and save compressed photos to your device.
SUPPORTED FILE TYPES
Compress Photos works with all PNG, JPEG, HEIF, and HEIC image files.
BEFORE AND AFTER SAMPLES
Before: 2.3MB — After: 207kb (91% smaller)
Before: 4.1MB — After: 492kb (88% smaller)
Before: 4.8MB — After: 384kb (92% smaller)
For best results, we recommend setting both compression settings to 80%, which should significantly reduce the file size without a noticeable difference to the naked eye. 
ADVANCED COMPRESSION TOOLS
Take full control of your photo compression with powerful advanced tools designed to provide more flexibility while keeping the app simple to use. Decide whether to keep or strip metadata and location details for better privacy and cleaner sharing. Choose your desired export format—perfect for compatibility across different platforms and use cases. And with smart file size estimation, you’ll know exactly how much space you’re saving before you even hit “Compress.”
PRO VERSION
Upgrade to the Pro version of Compress Photos to remove ads, access advanced compression settings, and compress more than 3 photos at once. 
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will auto-renew at the same price every year, unless canceled in your iTunes account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your account settings after purchase.
Terms of use: https://www.sixstarapps.com/terms/
Privacy policy: https://www.sixstarapps.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00032530:ios.description:
Network Scanner is a simple utility app that helps you explore your surroundings in fun and informative ways.
With a combination of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, magnetic field, and camera filter tools, you can better understand the environment around you and feel more confident wherever you are.
What it does:
- Wi-Fi & Bluetooth Device Finder – Scan nearby connections to see what devices are around you.
- Magnetometer Sensor – Detect changes in magnetic fields using your phone's built-in sensor.
- Infrared Camera Filters – Apply unique filters (green, red, blue, and monochrome) to discover what your camera sees in different visual layers.
- Simple & Accessible – Easy-to-use tools, no technical knowledge required.
Why Use Network Scanner?
- Explore Your Environment – See what's connected, what's nearby, and how signals behave.
- Stay Curious – Use filters and sensors to view the world in a new way.
- Peace of Mind – Feel more aware of your surroundings when traveling or at home.
Try Network Scanner today and take control of your privacy.

bluejetty:00068541:ios.description:
Organize your day to day accounts, loans, savings, investments and even crypto in a convenient and secure way with MoneyWiz. MoneyWiz is the only personal finance app that can help you manage every aspect of your finances. 
AT A GLANCE
+ Tracking for bank and credit accounts, loans and debts, budgets and goals, bills and subscriptions, investments and crypto;
+ Automatic download of new transactions through direct connections to your banks;
+ Cloud backup and automatic sync across your iPhones, iPads and Macs;
+ Advanced import features, so you can quickly move your data from other apps;
+ Military grade data security with 256bit end-to-end encryption;
+ Extensive tutorials and built-in support chat with a real humans!
[ GET 1 WEEK FREE TRIAL ]
Check our extensive features today!
CONNECTED BANK ACCOUNTS
+ 40,000 banks in 55 countries via 4 data providers
+ Apple Wallet integration
+ Automatic detection of Transfers and Refunds
+ Automatic categorization with AI and learning
+ Get notifications for every new transaction
MANUAL ACCOUNTS
+ Track manually if connected bank accounts is not for you
+ Complete control over your transaction entry form
+ Post transactions in connected accounts too
+ Import OFX, QIF, CSV and MT940
ALL ACCOUNTS
+ Group accounts any way you want
+ Bulk edit 
+ Reconcile against bank statements
+ Custom account icons
+ Multi-currency support with automatic refresh of currency rates
+ Archive old accounts
INVESTMENTS
+ Support for all your stock market investments, including stocks, options, bonds and more
+ Unmatched support for Crypto and Forex investments for a personal finance app
+ Handling for investments pre-IPO and pre-ICO
BUDGETS & GOALS
+ Versatile budgeting tools for various styles, including envelope budgeting
+ Group budgets anyway you want
+ Real time progress indicators 
BILLS & SUBSCRIPTIONS
+ Get alerted when it's time to pay or get paid
+ Never forget a payment again
+ Tap on the calendar for instant Forecast based on your scheduled payments
REPORTS
+ Analyze your money with 30+ reports
+ Save reports for easy access in the future
+ Group reports any way you want
+ Export reports to PDF, CSV or print them
WEEKLY IMPROVEMENTS
Check out our version history and road map. 
We deliver new improvements weekly, based on your feedback. 
SUBSCRIPTION
We do not impose a limit on the number of accounts, budgets, regular or scheduled transactions you can create in MoneyWiz for free. However, you will need a subscription to enable certain features:
+ Premium subscription ($4.99/month or $49.99/year) enables bank sync and multi-device sync with a MoneyWiz Cloud account
+ Standard subscription ($19.99/year) enables multi-device sync with a MoneyWiz Cloud account
Your subscriptions will automatically renew each month (or year, depending on plan) and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.
LINKS
Roadmap: https://wiz.money/roadmap
Privacy Policy: https://wiz.money/privacy/

apple-macos:1523968394.description:
## Featured by App Store in 150+ Countries & Regions
# Hot This Week
# Apps We Love Right Now
# Big Apps From Small Teams
# New Apps, Features, and Content
## What People Are Saying
"A simple, but valuable utility for creating timed focus sessions of productivity." - MacStories
"Focused Work helps you stay on track better than ever" - iMore
"Focused Work makes it easy to create and manage Focused Sessions." - 9to5Mac
"A tool that helps overcome that first step." - Knapsack
Focused Work is a powerful timer that helps you focus and be productive.
It's purpose-built for people who want to focus for long periods and struggle with this.
Add structure to your day with "Focus Sessions" that encourage you to complete goals, tasks, and help you divide your time into Focus, Break, and Prepare stages.
Pick from a selection of templates, including a simple timer, Pomodoro - inspired by the Pomodoro Technique, Flowmodoro - inspired by the Flowtime Technique, and other various sessions.
You can also create repeatable sessions specifically tailored to your needs. Add stages, set time limits, and much more.
Ultimately, Focused Work helps you be more accountable by reminding you to focus, reflect, and build healthy productivity habits by completing various daily goals.
**Core Features**
· A simple, powerful timer that keeps you on-task
Choose what to focus on. Start the timer. Get stuff done!
· Curated Basic Sessions to get started
Run a Pomodoro session, Flowmodoro session, or even just a simple timer
· Create Focus Sessions
Tailor them to your needs with a plethora of configurable options
· Reminders
Be reminded to stay focused, when to take breaks, and also to start a focus session!
· Reflection
Track what went well for you during your focus session and what you can improve upon
· Scratch Pad
Jot down thoughts that come to mind during your session and return to them after
· Daily Goals
Completing your daily focus goals earns you a streak and helps you form healthy productivity habits
· Statistics & Charts
Review recent productivity across the past week, month, and year
· Block Distractions
Select apps and websites you want to restrict access to during a session
· In-app Shortcuts Automation
Automatically perform actions as you progress through your session, such as turning on Focus
· Link with Toggl Track
Explore advanced time tracking by linking with Toggl to create time entries, assign projects and tags
· Productivity Export
Export completed sessions in CSV format
**iOS & iPadOS Features**
Focused Work is available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with extensive support for each platform;
· Live Activities
Control your session from the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island
· Interactive Widgets
Control your session, view daily goals, and start a session from the Home Screen
· Control Center Widgets
Start a session or access the Scratch Pad with Control Widgets
· StandBy
Interact with your session while iPhone is in StandBy
· Spotlight Search
Quick start and interact with sessions from search
· Focus Filters
Filter which sessions can be viewed & started based on the active Focus
· App Shortcuts & Siri
Start and interact with a session via various shortcuts that can also be linked together
· Picture-in-Picture
Show a floating timer above other apps with Picture-in-Picture mode
· Session Alerts on all devices
Start a session on one device and receive update alerts on others with Focused Work installed
· iCloud Syncing
Sync productivity stats & created sessions between devices
· Privacy Focused
Your data is securely stored and managed via iCloud. No account registration.
· And much more
Mac Support, Share Sheet controls, App Icons, Keyboard Shortcuts, VoiceOver, Split View & Slide Over, Low Power Mode, Drag & Drop, Dark Mode, URL Schemes
If you have any questions, please reach out to focusedworkapp@michaeltigas.com.au
Privacy Policy: https://focusedwork.app/privacypolicy/
Terms of Use: https://focusedwork.app/terms/

apple-macos:418794867.name: iCash SE
apple-macos:418794867.description:
iCash is a software intended to control your personal finances, keeping track of incomes, expenses, credits, debts and Banks transactions for you. As simple as creating the accounts you need and move money between them! You don't even need to know about accounting or even care about it! Your finances depend largely on good organization that lets you know where your money comes from and to where it goes.
iCash is an easy-to-use, full featured and multi-purpose Personal Finance Manager tool for Macintosh and Windows intended to help you control all kinds of money issues. iCash can serve several small accounting needs for either private users, or clubs, associations, self-employed, small businesses or simply to be used at home, making keeping track of incomes, expenses and Banks transactions a snap. With a few clicks you can begin creating accounts and making transactions in minutes.
iCash is versatile and user-friendly. For this reason it doesn't use the principle of double-entry bookkeeping making it much easier to be used by people with very little or no accounting knowledge at all. Simply create accounts for all your expenses, incomes, Banks... and start moving money between them! iCash will then allow you to find out where all your money comes from and where it goes. All accounts are well organized according to user-defined categories and built-in types so reports can be tailored to include all records or only ones meeting specified criteria. iCash also allows you to have as many money manager documents as necessary so you can control almost anything from Clubs, associations, home and so on at the same time.
iCash is available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Swedish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Czech, Catalan and Portuguese.
Key Features:
- No accounting knowledge required, no double-entry bookkeeping.
- Easy-to-use, straightforward and user-friendly all-in-one interface.
- Share your documents between your Mac and your PC hassle free.
- Unlimited Accounts, Categories and Contacts.
- Logical Account classification by category and type.
- Multiple currencies support with exchange rate manager.
- Transaction auto-balance and reconciliation.
- Scheduled and recurring transactions support.
- Full Budget support with customizable calculator.
- Project categorization of transactions for queries and reporting.
- Pre-defined customizable Reports.
- Advanced recordable Queries and Statistics.
- Chart creation by account, type, category including Profit & Loss.
- Fast Import and Export of Categories, Accounts and Transactions. (OFX, QIF, CSV)
- Powerful SQL database engine with auto-backup protection.
- Multi-document interface with password protection.

India's premium office commute. Reserved seats on AC buses across Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad and Kolkata — over 1 million rides every month.
Skip the crowded trains, surge-priced cabs and parking stress. Book a seat on a premium AC bus that runs on fixed routes from your neighbourhood to the city's biggest office hubs, with live tracking the whole way.
WHY RIDERS CHOOSE CITYFLO
• A seat that's always yours: every booking comes with a reserved seat. No standing, no sharing.
• Live tracking: watch your bus approach on the map, get boarding alerts, and follow your ride from your lock screen with Live Activities.
• On time, every day: high-frequency departures on busy corridors in the morning and evening office rush.
• Fair, predictable pricing: no surge — and ride packs that cut your daily fare further.
• Easy changes: reschedule to another timing or cancel when plans change.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with your mobile number.
2. Search your home and office stops.
3. Pick a route and timing that fits your day.
4. Choose your seat, pay with UPI, cards or Cityflo Cash — done.
RIDE PACKS
Commute daily? Lite Packs bundle your rides at a lower fare, with flexible validity. Start small with a 3-ride starter pack and upgrade when it clicks.
WHERE WE RUN
• Mumbai: Thane, Navi Mumbai, Borivali, Andheri and more — to Lower Parel, BKC, Powai, SoBo and beyond.
• Delhi NCR: Gurgaon, Dwarka, Rohini and more — to Cyber City, Udyog Vihar and key hubs.
• Hyderabad: Gachibowli, HITEC City, Financial District corridors.
• Kolkata: New Town, Sector V, and routes across the city's south and beyond.
New routes are added every month based on rider demand — suggest yours in the app.
Questions? Visit www.cityflo.com or write to support@cityflo.com.
Cityflo — get to work relaxed, get home on time.

apple-macos:6786180837.description:
Yoho VPN — a genuinely useful free VPN, with fast Pro nodes when you want more.
Most "free" VPNs pay for themselves by showing you ads or quietly selling your browsing history. Yoho doesn't. Our free plan is funded by our paid subscriptions — not by you.
WHY YOHO'S FREE PLAN IS DIFFERENT
• No ads — we never show or inject ads. Most free VPNs are ad-funded; we're not.
• You're never cut off — after your full-speed monthly data you simply slow down; you're not disconnected or locked out like most free tiers.
• No credit card. Free data every month, nothing to sign up for.
• Real features included free: Smart Split routing and Secure DNS — not a crippled trial.
FEATURES
• One-tap connect — open and go.
• Smart Split (China): WeChat, Alipay and 30+ mainland apps go direct — faster, and it saves your data.
• Secure DNS: defeats DNS pollution and hijacking so you always reach the real site.
• Nodes across multiple countries — pick the nearest for low latency (Pro).
• Ad & tracker blocking at the network layer for cleaner, faster browsing (Pro).
• Smart auto-routing: live latency testing hops you to the healthiest node (Pro).
• Kill switch: blocks traffic if the VPN drops, so your real IP never leaks.
• Public Wi-Fi protection on airport, hotel and café networks.
• Home & Lock Screen widgets: connect and check latency at a glance.
FREE VS PRO
• Free: Smart Split + Secure DNS, full-speed monthly data (then reduced speed).
• Pro: all nodes, ad blocking, smart auto-routing, and 200 GB/month at full speed.
REWARDS & PERKS
• Rewards Center — check in daily and invite friends to earn free high-speed data, and redeem more rewards.
• Help & Feedback — submit a ticket in-app and reach support directly.
NODE EXPERIENCE
• Nodes are grouped by country and city; favorite the ones you use most, and each shows a live load indicator so you can pick a quieter line.
SUBSCRIPTION
Yoho VPN offers monthly, quarterly and yearly Pro subscriptions that unlock all nodes and full-speed data.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the period.
• Manage or turn off auto-renewal anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://yohovpn.com/legal/terms
Support: support@yohovpn.com
